statements.subject: Art. 1
statements.object: scope: health and safety requirements for machinery design and construction
statements.quote: Article 1 Subject matter This Regulation lays down health and safety requirements for the design and construction of machinery, related products and partly completed machinery to allow them to be made available on the market or put into service while ensuring a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons, in particular consumers and professional users, and, where appropriate, of domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, of the environment. It also establishes rules on the free movement of products within the scope of this Regulation in the Union.

statements.subject: products within the scope of this Regulation
statements.object: machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph
statements.object_as_written: machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph
statements.object_normalised: machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph
statements.quote: For the purposes of this Regulation, machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph and partly completed machinery shall together be referred to as ‘products within the scope of this Regulation’.

statements.subject: Art. 2(2)
statements.object: Regulation excludes listed products, categories and uses from scope
statements.quote: This Regulation does not apply to: (a) safety components that are intended to be used as spare parts to replace identical components and are supplied by the manufacturer of the original machinery, related product or partly completed machinery;

statements.subject: Art. 3
statements.object: definitions listed after the introductory sentence are not in passage
statements.quote: Article 3 Definitions For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions apply:

statements.subject: machinery
statements.object: means:
statements.object_as_written: means:
statements.object_normalised: means:
statements.quote: (1) ‘machinery’ means: (a) an assembly, fitted with or intended to be fitted with a drive system other than directly applied human or animal effort, consisting of linked parts or components, at least one of which moves, and which are joined together for a specific application; (b) an assembly referred to in point (a), missing only the components to connect it on site or to sources of energy and motion;

statements.subject: interchangeable equipment
statements.object: means a device which
statements.object_as_written: means a device which
statements.object_normalised: means a device which
statements.condition: provided that the device is not a tool
statements.quote: (2) ‘interchangeable equipment’ means a device which, after the putting into service of machinery or an agricultural or forestry tractor, is assembled with that machinery or agricultural or forestry tractor by the operator in order to change its function or to attribute a new function to it, provided that the device is not a tool;

statements.subject: safety component
statements.object: ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component
statements.object_as_written: ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component
statements.object_normalised: ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component
statements.condition: but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function
statements.quote: (3) ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component, including software, of a product within the scope of this Regulation, which is designed or intended to fulfil a safety function and which is independently placed on the market, the failure or malfunction of which endanger the safety of persons, but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function;

statements.subject: lifting accessory
statements.object: a component or equipment, not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.object_as_written: a component or equipment, not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.object_normalised: a component or equipment, not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.quote: (5) ‘lifting accessory’ means a component or equipment, not attached to the lifting machinery, which enables the load to be held, which is placed between the machinery and the load or on the load itself, or which is intended to constitute an integral part of the load and which is independently placed on the market, including slings and their components;

statements.subject: chains
statements.object: chains designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_as_written: chains designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_normalised: chains designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.condition: as part of lifting machinery or lifting accessories
statements.quote: (6) ‘chains’ means chains designed and constructed for lifting purposes as part of lifting machinery or lifting accessories;

statements.subject: 'ropes'
statements.object: designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_as_written: designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_normalised: designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.quote: (7) ‘ropes’ means ropes designed and constructed for lifting purposes as part of lifting machinery or lifting accessories;

statements.subject: 'webbing'
statements.object: webbing designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_as_written: webbing designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.object_normalised: webbing designed and constructed for lifting purposes
statements.quote: (8) ‘webbing’ means webbing designed and constructed for lifting purposes as part of lifting machinery or lifting accessories;

statements.subject: removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object: removable component for transmitting power
statements.object_as_written: removable component for transmitting power
statements.object_normalised: removable component for transmitting power
statements.quote: (9) ‘removable mechanical transmission device’ means a removable component for transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and other machinery or related products by joining them at the first fixed bearing;

statements.subject: Art. 3(9)
statements.object: device and guard treated as one item when placed on market together
statements.quote: when it is placed on the market with a guard, the device and the guard are to be regarded as one item;

statements.subject: partly completed machinery
statements.object: an assembly which is not yet machinery
statements.object_as_written: an assembly which is not yet machinery
statements.object_normalised: an assembly which is not yet machinery
statements.quote: (10) ‘partly completed machinery’ means an assembly which is not yet machinery as it cannot in itself perform a specific application and which is only intended to be incorporated into or assembled with machinery or other partly completed machinery or equipment, thereby forming machinery;

statements.subject: making available on the market
statements.object: means any supply of a product
statements.object_as_written: means any supply of a product
statements.object_normalised: means any supply of a product
statements.condition: within the scope of this Regulation; in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge
statements.quote: (11) ‘making available on the market’ means any supply of a product within the scope of this Regulation for distribution or use on the Union market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge;

statements.subject: placing on the market
statements.object: the first making available of a product
statements.object_as_written: the first making available of a product
statements.object_normalised: the first making available of a product
statements.quote: (12) ‘placing on the market’ means the first making available of a product within the scope of this Regulation on the Union market;

statements.subject: putting into service
statements.object: the first use, for its intended purpose, in the union
statements.object_as_written: the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Union
statements.object_normalised: the first use, for its intended purpose, in the union
statements.quote: (13) ‘putting into service’ means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Union, of machinery or related products;

statements.subject: essential health and safety requirements
statements.object: the mandatory provisions, set out in annex iii
statements.object_as_written: the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III
statements.object_normalised: the mandatory provisions, set out in annex iii
statements.quote: (14) ‘essential health and safety requirements’ means the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III, relating to the design and construction of products within the scope of this Regulation to ensure a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons, and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, of the environment;

statements.subject: substantial modification
statements.object: a modification of machinery or a related product
statements.object_as_written: a modification of machinery or a related product
statements.object_normalised: a modification of machinery or a related product
statements.condition: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer
statements.quote: (16) ‘substantial modification’ means a modification of machinery or a related product, by physical or digital means after that machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service, which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer, and which affects the safety of that machinery or related product, by creating a new hazard, or by increasing an existing risk, which requires:

statements.subject: Art. 3(16)
statements.object: criteria (a)/(b) for substantial modification, guards or stability measures
statements.quote: (a) the addition of guards or protective devices to that machinery or related product the processing of which necessitates the modification of the existing safety control system; or (b) the adoption of additional protective measures to ensure the stability or mechanical strength of that machinery or related product;

statements.subject: instructions for use
statements.object: the information, provided by the manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: the information, provided by the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: the information, provided by the manufacturer
statements.quote: (17) ‘instructions for use’ means the information, provided by the manufacturer when the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service, to inform the user of the machinery or related product, of the intended and proper use of that machinery or related product, as well as information on any precautions to be taken when using or installing the machinery or related product, including information on the safety aspects, and on how to keep that machinery or related product safe, and to ensure that it remains fit for purpose during its entire lifetime;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: any natural or legal person who
statements.object_as_written: any natural or legal person who
statements.object_normalised: any natural or legal person who
statements.quote: (18) ‘manufacturer’ means any natural or legal person who:

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: markets those products under its name or trademark
statements.object_as_written: markets those products under its name or trademark
statements.object_normalised: markets those products under its name or trademark
statements.condition: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured
statements.quote: (a) manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured, and markets those products under its name or trademark;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: puts those products into service for its own use
statements.object_as_written: puts those products into service for its own use
statements.object_normalised: puts those products into service for its own use
statements.condition: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation
statements.quote: or (b) manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation, and puts those products into service for its own use;

statements.subject: authorised representative
statements.object: any natural or legal person established within the union
statements.object_as_written: any natural or legal person established within the Union
statements.object_normalised: any natural or legal person established within the union
statements.quote: (19) ‘authorised representative’ means any natural or legal person established within the Union who has received a written mandate from a manufacturer to act on its behalf in relation to specified tasks;

statements.subject: importer
statements.object: any natural or legal person established within the union
statements.object_as_written: any natural or legal person established within the Union
statements.object_normalised: any natural or legal person established within the union
statements.quote: (20) ‘importer’ means any natural or legal person established within the Union who places a product within the scope of this Regulation from a third country on the Union market;

statements.subject: distributor
statements.object: any natural or legal person in the supply chain
statements.object_as_written: any natural or legal person in the supply chain
statements.object_normalised: any natural or legal person in the supply chain
statements.condition: other than the manufacturer or the importer
statements.quote: (21) ‘distributor’ means any natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the manufacturer or the importer, who makes a product within the scope of this Regulation available on the market;

statements.subject: economic operator
statements.object: means the manufacturer, the authorised representative
statements.object_as_written: means the manufacturer, the authorised representative
statements.object_normalised: means the manufacturer, the authorised representative
statements.quote: (22) ‘economic operator’ means the manufacturer, the authorised representative, the importer or the distributor;

statements.subject: technical specifications
statements.object: a document that prescribes technical requirements
statements.object_as_written: a document that prescribes technical requirements
statements.object_normalised: a document that prescribes technical requirements
statements.quote: (23) ‘technical specifications’ means a document that prescribes technical requirements to be fulfilled by products within the scope of this Regulation;

statements.subject: harmonised standard
statements.object: means a harmonised standard as defined in article 2
statements.object_as_written: means a harmonised standard as defined in Article 2
statements.object_normalised: means a harmonised standard as defined in article 2
statements.quote: (24) ‘harmonised standard’ means a harmonised standard as defined in Article 2, point 1, point (c), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012;

statements.subject: CE marking
statements.object: a marking by which the manufacturer indicates
statements.object_as_written: a marking by which the manufacturer indicates
statements.object_normalised: a marking by which the manufacturer indicates
statements.quote: (25) ‘CE marking’ means a marking by which the manufacturer indicates that machinery or a related product is in conformity with the applicable requirements set out in Union harmonisation legislation providing for its affixing;

statements.subject: accreditation
statements.object: article 2, point (10), of regulation (ec) no 765/2008
statements.object_as_written: Article 2, point (10), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008
statements.object_normalised: article 2, point (10), of regulation (ec) no 765/2008
statements.quote: (26) ‘accreditation’ means accreditation as defined in Article 2, point (10), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008;

statements.subject: national accreditation body
statements.object: a national accreditation body as defined in article 2, point (11)
statements.object_as_written: a national accreditation body as defined in Article 2, point (11)
statements.object_normalised: a national accreditation body as defined in article 2, point (11)
statements.quote: (27) ‘national accreditation body’ means a national accreditation body as defined in Article 2, point (11), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008;

statements.subject: conformity assessment
statements.object: means the process for demonstrating
statements.object_as_written: means the process for demonstrating
statements.object_normalised: means the process for demonstrating
statements.quote: (28) ‘conformity assessment’ means the process for demonstrating whether the applicable essential health and safety requirements in this Regulation relating to machinery or related products have been fulfilled;

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: a body that performs conformity assessment activities
statements.object_as_written: a body that performs conformity assessment activities
statements.object_normalised: a body that performs conformity assessment activities
statements.quote: (29) ‘conformity assessment body’ means a body that performs conformity assessment activities, including calibration, testing, certification and inspection;

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this regulation
statements.object_as_written: conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation
statements.object_normalised: conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this regulation
statements.quote: (30) ‘notified body’ means a conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation;

statements.subject: market surveillance authority
statements.object: as defined in article 3, point (4)
statements.object_as_written: as defined in Article 3, point (4)
statements.object_normalised: as defined in article 3, point (4)
statements.quote: (31) ‘market surveillance authority’ means a ‘market surveillance authority’ as defined in Article 3, point (4), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020;

statements.subject: recall
statements.object: any measure aimed at achieving the return of a product
statements.object_as_written: any measure aimed at achieving the return of a product
statements.object_normalised: any measure aimed at achieving the return of a product
statements.condition: within the scope of this Regulation that has already been made available to a user
statements.quote: (32) ‘recall’ means any measure aimed at achieving the return of a product within the scope of this Regulation that has already been made available to a user;

statements.subject: withdrawal
statements.object: any measure aimed at preventing a product
statements.object_as_written: any measure aimed at preventing a product
statements.object_normalised: any measure aimed at preventing a product
statements.condition: a product within the scope of this Regulation that is in the supply chain
statements.quote: (33) ‘withdrawal’ means, for a product, any measure aimed at preventing a product within the scope of this Regulation that is in the supply chain from being made available on the market;

statements.subject: lifetime
statements.object: the period from the moment that machinery
statements.object_as_written: the period from the moment that machinery
statements.object_normalised: the period from the moment that machinery
statements.quote: (34) ‘lifetime’ means the period from the moment that machinery or a related product is placed on the market or put into service until the moment that it is discarded, including the effective time when the machinery or related product is capable of being used and the phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling, scrapping or other physical or digital modifications foreseen by the manufacturer;

statements.subject: source code
statements.object: the currently installed version of the software
statements.object_as_written: the currently installed version of the software
statements.object_normalised: the currently installed version of the software
statements.condition: software of a product within the scope of this Regulation
statements.quote: (35) ‘source code’ means the currently installed version of the software of a product within the scope of this Regulation, written in a programming language so that it is unambiguous and understandable to humans;

statements.subject: professional user
statements.object: a natural person who uses or operates machinery
statements.object_as_written: a natural person who uses or operates machinery
statements.object_normalised: a natural person who uses or operates machinery
statements.condition: in the course of his or her professional activity or work
statements.quote: (36) ‘professional user’ means a natural person who uses or operates machinery or a related product in the course of his or her professional activity or work.

statements.subject: Art. 4(1)
statements.object: Member States must not impede market availability or service entry of compliant products
statements.quote: Member States shall not impede, for reasons relating to the aspects covered by this Regulation, the making available on the market of products within the scope of this Regulation or the putting into service of machinery or related products which comply with this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 4(2)
statements.object: Non-compliant products may be displayed at fairs with visible sign
statements.quote: At trade fairs, exhibitions and demonstrations or similar events, Member States shall not prevent the display of a product within the scope of this Regulation which does not comply with this Regulation, provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that it does not comply with this Regulation and will not be made available on the market until it has been brought into conformity.

statements.subject: Art. 5
statements.object: Member States may set requirements for protection during installation or use
statements.quote: Article 5 Protection of persons during installation or use of machinery or related products Member States may lay down requirements to ensure that persons, including workers, are protected when installing or using machinery or related products, provided that such rules do not allow for the modification of machinery or a related product in a way that is not compatible with this Regulation.

statements.subject: machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A
statements.object: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)
statements.object_as_written: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2)
statements.object_normalised: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)
statements.quote: Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3).

statements.subject: machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)
statements.object_as_written: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3)
statements.object_normalised: specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)
statements.quote: Machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part A, shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2), and machinery and related products that fall within the categories listed in Annex I, Part B shall be subject to the specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3).

statements.subject: Art. 6(2)
statements.object: Commission empowered to amend Annex I by delegated acts
statements.quote: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to amend Annex I, after consulting the stakeholders concerned, in the light of technical progress, advances in knowledge or new scientific evidence by adding to the list of categories of machinery and related products in Annex I a new category of machinery or related products, withdrawing an existing category of machinery or related products from that list or moving a category of machinery or related products from one Part of Annex I to another Part of that Annex, in accordance with the criteria and the procedures laid down in paragraphs 4, 5 and 7 of this Article.

statements.subject: Art. 6(3)
statements.object: Commission must consult relevant expert group before delegated act
statements.quote: Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall seek the views of experts in the relevant expert group in accordance with Article 47(4).

statements.subject: categories of machinery and related products
statements.object: listed in annex i
statements.object_as_written: listed in Annex I
statements.object_normalised: listed in annex i
statements.quote: Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures.

statements.subject: Art. 6(4)
statements.object: Commission criteria for adding or withdrawing categories from Annex I
statements.quote: The Commission shall assess the seriousness of the inherent potential risk presented by a category of machinery or related product for the purpose of determining whether to add that category of machinery or related product to Annex I or to withdraw that category of machinery or related product from Annex I. That assessment shall be established based on the combination of the probability of occurrence of harm and the severity of that harm. In determining the probability and severity of harm, the following criteria shall, where relevant, be taken into account:

statements.subject: Art. 6(5)
statements.object: Commission must consider accident and damage data for at least the preceding four years
statements.quote: (d) data on accidents or damage to health caused by the machinery or related product for at least the preceding four years.

statements.subject: Art. 6(6)
statements.object: Member States provide paragraph 5(a)-(d) data per paragraph 9
statements.quote: The data and information referred to in paragraph 5, points (a) to (d), shall be provided by Member States in accordance with paragraph 9.

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product
statements.object: annex i, part a
statements.object_as_written: Annex I, Part A
statements.object_normalised: annex i, part a
statements.condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled
statements.quote: A category of machinery or related product shall be included in Annex I, Part A, if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, including the data referred to in paragraph 5, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled:

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product not fulfilling points (a) to (d)
statements.object: annex i, part b
statements.object_as_written: Annex I, Part B
statements.object_normalised: annex i, part b
statements.condition: does not fulfil one or more of the conditions in points (a) to (d)
statements.quote: Any other category of machinery or related product that, according to that assessment, presents a serious inherent potential risk but does not fulfil one or more of the conditions in points (a) to (d) shall be included in Annex I, Part B.

statements.subject: Art. 6(8)
statements.object: Member State must inform Commission of concerns; Commission assessment duty
statements.quote: A Member State which has concerns about a category of machinery or related product being listed or not in Annex I shall immediately inform the Commission of those concerns and provide reasons in support thereof. The Commission shall conduct the assessment referred to in paragraph 4 immediately after being informed by a Member State. After making that assessment, the Commission may initiate the procedure laid down in paragraph 2.

statements.subject: Art. 6(9)
statements.object: Member States report data by 14 July 2025, then every five years
statements.quote: By 14 July 2025, and every five years thereafter, Member States shall provide the data and information referred to in paragraph 5, including information to the effect that none of the events referred to in paragraph 5 has occurred, for every category of machinery or related products which is included in Annex I or which is not included in Annex I where that non-inclusion is a cause of concern for the Member State.

statements.subject: Art. 6(10)
statements.object: Commission deadline for first implementing act: 14 July 2024
statements.quote: The first such implementing act shall be adopted not later than 14 July 2024.

statements.subject: Art. 6(11)
statements.object: Commission delegated act on Member States data obligations
statements.quote: If necessary after the Commission report referred to in Article 53(3), the Commission shall adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to supplement paragraph 5 of this Article by specifying the obligations of Member States to provide data and information required pursuant to this Article through the establishment of a common methodology concerning the data and information to be collected, including the methods for their collection and compilation, and the procedures for their transmission, as well as the relevant definitions, in order to ensure that sufficient and comparable data is available for the Commission to carry out the assessment referred to in paragraph 4.

statements.subject: safety components
statements.object: annex ii
statements.object_as_written: Annex II
statements.object_normalised: annex ii
statements.quote: An indicative list of safety components is set out in Annex II.

statements.subject: indicative list of safety components
statements.object: annex II
statements.object_as_written: Annex II
statements.object_normalised: annex II
statements.condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence
statements.quote: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to amend Annex II in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence by including a new safety component in the indicative list of safety components or withdrawing an existing safety component from that list.

statements.subject: Art. 7(2)
statements.object: Commission delegated-act power to amend Annex II under Article 47
statements.quote: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to amend Annex II in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence by including a new safety component in the indicative list of safety components or withdrawing an existing safety component from that list.

statements.subject: Art. 7(3)
statements.object: Member State must immediately inform Commission of safety component concerns
statements.quote: A Member State which has concerns about a safety component being listed or not listed in Annex II shall immediately inform the Commission of its concerns and provide reasons in support thereof.

statements.subject: Art. 8
statements.object: Machinery placed on market must meet Annex III requirements
statements.quote: Article 8 Essential health and safety requirements for products within the scope of this Regulation Machinery or related products shall only be made available on the market or put into service if, where properly installed and maintained and used for their intended use or under conditions which can reasonably be foreseen, they meet the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III. Partly completed machinery shall only be made available on the market if it meets the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III.

statements.subject: Art. 9
statements.object: Regulation does not apply where more specific Union legislation covers same risks
statements.quote: Article 9 Specific Union harmonisation legislation Where, for a certain product within the scope of this Regulation, the risks addressed by the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III are wholly or partly covered by Union harmonisation legislation that is more specific than this Regulation, this Regulation shall not apply to that product to the extent that that specific Union legislation covers such risks.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed
statements.condition: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service
statements.quote: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service, manufacturers shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed in accordance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: draw up the technical documentation set out in annex iv, part a
statements.object_as_written: draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A
statements.object_normalised: draw up the technical documentation set out in annex iv, part a
statements.condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service
statements.quote: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service, manufacturers shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A and carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 or have it carried out.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in article 25 or have it carried out
statements.object_as_written: carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 or have it carried out
statements.object_normalised: carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in article 25 or have it carried out
statements.condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service
statements.quote: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service, manufacturers shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A and carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25 or have it carried out.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21
statements.object_as_written: draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21
statements.object_normalised: draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21
statements.condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure
statements.quote: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure, manufacturers shall draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 and affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: affix the ce marking in accordance with article 24
statements.object_as_written: affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24
statements.object_normalised: affix the ce marking in accordance with article 24
statements.condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure
statements.quote: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure, manufacturers shall draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 and affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24.

statements.subject: technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity
statements.object: P10Y
statements.object_as_written: at least 10 years
statements.object_normalised: P10Y
statements.condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service
statements.quote: Manufacturers shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service.

statements.subject: manufacturers, source code or programming logic in technical documentation
statements.object: be made available to the competent national authorities
statements.object_as_written: be made available to the competent national authorities
statements.object_normalised: be made available to the competent national authorities
statements.condition: Where relevant, upon a reasoned request, if that source code or programming logic is necessary in order for them to be able to check compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III
statements.quote: Where relevant, the source code or the programming logic included in the technical documentation shall, upon a reasoned request, be made available to the competent national authorities, if that source code or programming logic is necessary in order for them to be able to check compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III.

statements.subject: manufacturers
statements.object: shall ensure that procedures are in place

statements.object: provide that authority with all the information and documentation
statements.object_as_written: provide that authority with all the information and documentation
statements.object_normalised: provide that authority with all the information and documentation
statements.condition: further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority
statements.quote: Distributors shall, further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation, in paper or digital format, necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the partly completed machinery with this Regulation.

statements.subject: Distributors
statements.object: cooperate with that authority
statements.object_as_written: cooperate with that authority
statements.object_normalised: cooperate with that authority
statements.condition: at its request
statements.quote: They shall cooperate with that authority, at its request, on any action taken to eliminate the risks as regards the essential health and safety requirements presented by partly completed machinery which they have made available on the market.

statements.subject: importer or distributor
statements.object_as_written: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected
statements.condition: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected
statements.quote: Article 17 Cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply to importers and distributors An importer or distributor shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation, and shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10 and 11, where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected.

statements.subject: importer or distributor
statements.object_as_written: subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10 and 11
statements.condition: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected
statements.quote: Article 17 Cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply to importers and distributors An importer or distributor shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation, and shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10 and 11, where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected.

statements.subject: natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification
statements.object: shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in article 10
statements.object_as_written: shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10
statements.object_normalised: shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in article 10
statements.condition: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery
statements.quote: Article 18 Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply A natural or legal person that carries out a substantial modification of machinery or a related product shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 for that machinery or related product or, if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery, for that affected machinery or related product, as demonstrated in the risk assessment.

statements.subject: person who carries out substantial modification
statements.object: ensure and declare on its sole responsibility
statements.object_as_written: ensure and declare on its sole responsibility
statements.object_normalised: ensure and declare on its sole responsibility
statements.quote: The person who carries out the substantial modification shall in particular, but without prejudice to other obligations set out in Article 10, ensure and declare on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the applicable requirements of this Regulation and shall apply the relevant conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) of this Regulation.

statements.subject: machinery or related product substantially modified
statements.object: conformity assessment procedure as provided in article 25 (2), (3) and (4)
statements.object_as_written: conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4)
statements.object_normalised: conformity assessment procedure as provided in article 25 (2), (3) and (4)
statements.quote: The person who carries out the substantial modification shall in particular, but without prejudice to other obligations set out in Article 10, ensure and declare on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the applicable requirements of this Regulation and shall apply the relevant conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) of this Regulation.

statements.subject: non-professional user modifying machinery for own use
statements.object: shall not be considered to be a manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: shall not be considered to be a manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: shall not be considered to be a manufacturer
statements.condition: for his or her own use
statements.quote: A non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification to his or her machinery or related product, for his or her own use, shall not be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10.

statements.subject: non-professional user modifying machinery for own use
statements.object: shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in article 10
statements.object_as_written: shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10
statements.object_normalised: shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in article 10
statements.condition: for his or her own use
statements.quote: A non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification to his or her machinery or related product, for his or her own use, shall not be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10.

statements.subject: economic operators
statements.object: shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities
statements.object_as_written: shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities
statements.object_normalised: shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities
statements.condition: on request
statements.quote: Economic operators shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities: (a) any economic operator who has supplied them with a product within the scope of this Regulation; (b) any economic operator to whom they have supplied a product within the scope of this Regulation.

statements.subject: economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1
statements.object: P10Y
statements.object_as_written: at least 10 years
statements.object_normalised: P10Y
statements.quote: In order to be able to comply with the obligation in paragraph 1, economic operators shall retain the information referred to in that paragraph for at least 10 years after they supplied or were supplied with the products within the scope of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 20(1)
statements.object: Presumption of conformity via published harmonised standards
statements.quote: A product within the scope of this Regulation which is in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III covered by those standards or parts thereof.

statements.subject: Art. 20(2)
statements.object: Commission to request harmonised standards for Annex III requirements
statements.quote: The Commission shall, as provided in Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, request one or more European standardisation organisations to draft harmonised standards for the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III.

statements.subject: Art. 20(3)
statements.object: Commission common specifications adoptable only if conditions (a) and (b) are met
statements.quote: Those implementing acts shall only be adopted where the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) the Commission has requested, pursuant to Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, one or more European standardisation organisations to draft a harmonised standard for the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III and:

statements.subject: Art. 20(4)
statements.object: Commission informs committee before drafting implementing act
statements.quote: 4. Before preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 3, the Commission shall inform the committee referred to in Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 that it considers that the conditions in paragraph 3 have been fulfilled.

statements.subject: Art. 20(5)
statements.object: Commission must consult bodies and stakeholders when preparing draft implementing act
statements.quote: When preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 3, the Commission shall take into account the views of relevant bodies or the expert group and shall duly consult all relevant stakeholders.

statements.subject: Art. 20(6)
statements.object: presumption of conformity via common specifications, not a schema relation
statements.quote: A product within the scope of this Regulation which is in conformity with the common specifications established by implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof, shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III covered by those common specifications or parts thereof.

statements.subject: Art. 20(7)
statements.object: Commission must repeal implementing acts on publication of harmonised standard reference; no date stated
statements.quote: When reference of a harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal of the European Union , the Commission shall repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof which cover the same essential health and safety requirements as those covered by that harmonised standard.

statements.subject: Art. 20(8)
statements.object: Member State must notify Commission of common specification gaps
statements.quote: When a Member State considers that a common specification does not entirely satisfy the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, it shall inform the Commission thereof by submitting a detailed explanation. The Commission shall assess that detailed explanation and may, if appropriate, amend the implementing act establishing the common specification in question.

statements.subject: Art. 20(9)
statements.object: Presumed conformity with Annex III 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 if cybersecurity-certified
statements.quote: Machinery and related products that have been certified or for which a statement of conformity has been issued under a cybersecurity certification scheme adopted in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2019/881 the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1, as regards protection against corruption and safety and reliability of control systems insofar as those requirements are covered by the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof.

statements.subject: Art. 21(1)
statements.object: EU declaration must state Annex III requirements demonstrated
statements.quote: The EU declaration of conformity shall state that the fulfilment of the applicable essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated.

statements.subject: Art. 21(2)
statements.object: Declaration duties are stated for the document, not an economic operator; modules unassigned
statements.quote: The EU declaration of conformity shall have the model structure set out in Annex V, Part A, and shall contain the elements specified in the relevant modules set out in Annexes VI, VIII, IX, and X. It shall be continuously updated and shall be translated into the language or languages required by the Member State in which the machinery or related product is placed on the market, is made available on the market or put into service.

statements.subject: Art. 21(3)
statements.object: Single EU declaration for multiple acts; no operator named
statements.quote: Where machinery or a related product is subject to more than one Union legal act that requires an EU declaration of conformity, a single EU declaration of conformity shall be drawn up in respect of all such acts. That declaration shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.object_as_written: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.object_normalised: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.condition: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity
statements.quote: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the manufacturer shall assume responsibility for the compliance of the machinery or related product with the requirements laid down in this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 22(1)
statements.object: Incorporation declaration must state Annex III requirements demonstrated
statements.quote: Article 22 EU declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery. 1. The EU declaration of incorporation shall state that the fulfilment of the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated.

statements.subject: Art. 22(2)
statements.object: Declaration: Annex V Part B model, updated, translated; no addressee
statements.quote: The EU declaration of incorporation shall have the model structure set out in Annex V, Part B. It shall be continually updated and shall be translated into the language or languages required by the Member State in which the partly completed machinery is placed on the market or is made available on the market.

statements.subject: EU declaration of incorporation
statements.object: shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts
statements.object_as_written: shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts
statements.object_normalised: shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts
statements.condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity
statements.quote: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity, the EU declaration of incorporation shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts.

statements.subject: EU declaration of incorporation
statements.object: shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references
statements.object_as_written: shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned
statements.object_normalised: shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references
statements.condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity
statements.quote: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity, the EU declaration of incorporation shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts. That declaration shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references.

statements.subject: Art. 22(3)
statements.object: Obligated party not named in passage
statements.quote: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity, the EU declaration of incorporation shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts. That declaration shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.object_as_written: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.object_normalised: shall assume responsibility for the compliance
statements.condition: By drawing up the EU declaration of incorporation
statements.quote: By drawing up the EU declaration of incorporation, the manufacturer shall assume responsibility for the compliance of the partly completed machinery with the requirements laid down in this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 23
statements.object: CE marking subject to general principles of Regulation 765/2008 Art. 30
statements.quote: Article 23 General principles of the CE marking The CE marking shall be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.

statements.subject: Art. 24(1)
statements.object: CE marking placement rule; no relation fits
statements.quote: The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly to the machinery or related product. Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the machinery or related product, it shall be affixed to the packaging and to the documents accompanying the machinery or related product.

statements.subject: Art. 24(2)
statements.object: CE marking timing; no economic operator named
statements.quote: The CE marking shall be affixed before the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service.

statements.subject: notified body identification number affixing
statements.object: shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer
statements.condition: Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed
statements.quote: The identification number of that notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or the manufacturer’s authorised representative.

statements.subject: Art. 24(3)
statements.object: CE marking followed by notified body identification number
statements.quote: Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed in accordance with the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25(2), points (a), (b) and (c) and in Article 25(3), points (b), (c) and (d), the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure.

statements.subject: Art. 24(4)
statements.object: permission to add pictogram after CE marking, no fitting relation
statements.quote: The CE marking and, where applicable, the identification number of the notified body may be followed by a pictogram or any other marking indicating a special risk or use.

statements.subject: Art. 24(5)
statements.object: Member States must enforce correct CE marking use, not an economic operator
statements.quote: Member States shall build upon existing mechanisms to ensure correct application of the regime governing the CE marking and shall take appropriate action in the event of improper use of that marking.

statements.subject: manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18
statements.object: shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures
statements.object_as_written: shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures
statements.object_normalised: shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures
statements.quote: The manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures referred to in paragraphs 2, 3 and 4.

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product
statements.object: eu type-examination (module b)
statements.object_as_written: EU type-examination (module B)
statements.object_normalised: eu type-examination (module b)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product
statements.object: conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)
statements.object_as_written: conformity to type based on internal production control (module C)
statements.object_normalised: conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)
statements.condition: followed by EU type-examination (module B), under option (a)
statements.quote: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product
statements.object: conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)
statements.object_as_written: conformity based on full quality assurance (module H)
statements.object_normalised: conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A
statements.quote: (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX;

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product
statements.object: conformity based on unit verification (module g)
statements.object_as_written: conformity based on unit verification (module G)
statements.object_normalised: conformity based on unit verification (module g)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A
statements.quote: (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall apply one of the following procedures
statements.object_as_written: shall apply one of the following procedures
statements.object_normalised: shall apply one of the following procedures
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:
