statements.object_as_written: Annex I, Part A
statements.object_normalised: annex i, part a
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:

statements.subject: machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: internal production control (module a)
statements.object_as_written: internal production control (module A)
statements.object_normalised: internal production control (module a)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.quote: (a) internal production control (module A) set out in Annex VI;

statements.subject: machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: eu type-examination (module b)
statements.object_as_written: EU type-examination (module B)
statements.object_normalised: eu type-examination (module b)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.quote: (b) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;

statements.subject: machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)
statements.object_as_written: conformity to type based on internal production control (module C)
statements.object_normalised: conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.quote: (b) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;

statements.subject: machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)
statements.object_as_written: conformity based on full quality assurance (module H)
statements.object_normalised: conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.quote: (c) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX;

statements.subject: machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object: conformity based on unit verification (module g)
statements.object_as_written: conformity based on unit verification (module G)
statements.object_normalised: conformity based on unit verification (module g)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.quote: (d) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X.

statements.subject: machinery or related product category
statements.object: listed in annex i, part b
statements.object_as_written: listed in Annex I, Part B
statements.object_normalised: listed in annex i, part b
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:

statements.subject: manufacturer applying internal production control
statements.object: it shall design and construct the machinery or related product
statements.object_as_written: it shall design and construct the machinery or related product
statements.object_normalised: it shall design and construct the machinery or related product
statements.condition: if a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a)
statements.quote: If a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a), it shall design and construct the machinery or related product in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements.

statements.subject: machinery category not designed per harmonised standards
statements.object: shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d)
statements.object_as_written: shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d)
statements.object_normalised: shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d)
statements.condition: the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, and the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements for that category of machinery or related product, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d) of this paragraph.

statements.subject: category of machinery or related product not listed in Annex I
statements.object: internal production control procedure (module A)
statements.object_as_written: internal production control procedure (module A)
statements.object_normalised: internal production control procedure (module A)
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply the internal production control procedure (module A) set out in Annex VI.

statements.subject: manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18
statements.object: shall apply the internal production control procedure
statements.object_as_written: shall apply the internal production control procedure
statements.object_normalised: shall apply the internal production control procedure
statements.condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I
statements.quote: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply the internal production control procedure (module A) set out in Annex VI.

statements.subject: Art. 25(5)
statements.object: notified bodies must consider SME interests when setting fees
statements.quote: Notified bodies shall take into account the specific interests and needs of small and medium sized enterprises when setting the fees for conformity assessment.

statements.subject: Art. 26
statements.object: Member States notify bodies authorised for conformity assessment
statements.quote: Article 26 Notification Member States shall notify the Commission and the other Member States of bodies authorised to carry out third-party conformity assessment tasks in accordance with this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 27(1)
statements.object: Member States must designate a notifying authority for conformity assessment bodies
statements.quote: Member States shall designate a notifying authority that shall be responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies, including compliance with Article 32.

statements.subject: Art. 27(2)
statements.object: Member States may delegate notifying-authority assessment and monitoring to national accreditation body
statements.quote: 2. Member States may decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 shall be carried out by a national accreditation body, as defined in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 in accordance with that Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 27(3)
statements.object: delegated non-governmental body must be legal entity, comply with Art. 28, and have liability arrangements
statements.quote: Where the notifying authority delegates or otherwise entrusts the assessment, notification or monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 to a body, which is not a governmental entity, that body shall be a legal entity and shall comply mutatis mutandis with the requirements laid down in Article 28. In addition, that body shall have arrangements in place to cover liabilities arising out of its activities.

statements.subject: Art. 27(4)
statements.object: notifying authority takes full responsibility for body's tasks
statements.quote: The notifying authority shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by the body referred to in paragraph 3.

statements.subject: Art. 28(1)
statements.object: Notifying authority must avoid conflict of interest with conformity bodies
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall be established in such a way that no conflict of interest with conformity assessment bodies occurs.

statements.subject: Art. 28(2)
statements.object: notifying authority must safeguard objectivity and impartiality
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall be organised and operated so as to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of its activities.

statements.subject: Art. 28(3)
statements.object: Notifying authority must separate decision-makers from assessors; not an economic operator
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall be organised in such a way that each decision relating to notification of a conformity assessment body is taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment.

statements.subject: Art. 28(4)
statements.object: Notifying authority barred from conformity-assessment activities and commercial consultancy
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall not offer or provide any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform, nor shall it offer or provide consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.

statements.subject: Art. 28(5)
statements.object: Notifying authority must safeguard confidentiality of information obtained
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information it obtains.

statements.subject: Art. 28(6)
statements.object: notifying authority must have sufficient competent personnel
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall have a sufficient number of competent personnel at its disposal for the proper performance of its tasks.

statements.subject: Art. 29
statements.object: Member States must inform Commission of notified body procedures
statements.quote: Article 29 Information obligation of notifying authorities Member States shall inform the Commission of their procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies, and of any changes thereto. The Commission shall make that information publicly available.

statements.subject: Art. 30(1)
statements.object: Notified body requirements in paragraphs 2 to 11
statements.quote: For the purposes of notification, a conformity assessment body shall meet the requirements laid down in paragraphs 2 to 11.

statements.subject: Art. 30(2)
statements.object: Notified body must be established under national law with legal personality
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall be established under the national law of a Member State and shall have legal personality.

statements.subject: Art. 30(3)
statements.object: conformity assessment body must be independent third party; business association conditional
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall be a third-party body that is independent of the organisation or of the machinery or related product that it assesses. A body belonging to a business association or professional federation representing undertakings involved in the design, manufacture, provision, assembly, use or maintenance of machinery or related products which it assesses, may, on condition that its independence and the absence of any conflict of interest are demonstrated, be considered such a conformity assessment body.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall not be the designer, manufacturer, supplier
statements.object_as_written: shall not be the designer, manufacturer, supplier
statements.object_normalised: shall not be the designer, manufacturer, supplier
statements.condition: of machinery or related products that they assess; This shall not preclude the use of assessed machinery
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall not be the designer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of machinery or related products that they assess, nor shall it fulfil any of those roles in relation to partly completed machinery that has been incorporated into the assessed product or be the representative of any of those parties. This shall not preclude the use of assessed machinery or related products that are necessary for the operations of the conformity assessment body or the use of machinery or related products for personal purposes.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall not be directly involved in the design, import, distribution, manufacture, marketing, installation, use or maintenance
statements.object_as_written: shall not be directly involved in the design
statements.object_normalised: shall not be directly involved in the design, import, distribution, manufacture, marketing, installation, use or maintenance
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body, its top-level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall not be directly involved in the design, import, distribution, manufacture, marketing, installation, use or maintenance of the machinery or related products, or represent the parties engaged in those activities.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body, its top-level management and personnel
statements.object: shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity
statements.object_as_written: shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence of judgement
statements.object_normalised: shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity
statements.condition: in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified
statements.quote: They shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall ensure that the activities of its subsidiaries or subcontractors do not affect the confidentiality, objectivity or impartiality
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that the activities of its subsidiaries
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that the activities of its subsidiaries or subcontractors do not affect the confidentiality, objectivity or impartiality
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall ensure that the activities of its subsidiaries or subcontractors do not affect the confidentiality, objectivity or impartiality of its conformity assessment activities.

statements.subject: Art. 30(4)
statements.object: consultancy services named as an example of conflicting activity
statements.quote: This shall in particular apply to consultancy services.

statements.subject: Art. 30(5)
statements.object: Notified-body integrity and independence duties; not an economic operator
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body and its personnel shall carry out the conformity assessment activities with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite technical competence in the specific field and shall be free from all pressures and inducements, particularly financial, which might influence its judgement or the results of its conformity assessment activities, especially as regards persons or groups of persons with an interest in the results of those activities.

statements.subject: Art. 30(8)
statements.object: Impartiality and pay-independence duties of notified bodies; no matching relation
statements.quote: The impartiality of a conformity assessment body, its top-level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall be guaranteed. The remuneration of the top-level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall not depend on the number of conformity assessments carried out or on the results of those assessments.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall take out liability insurance
statements.object_as_written: shall take out liability insurance
statements.object_normalised: shall take out liability insurance
statements.condition: unless liability is assumed by the Member State in accordance with national law, or the Member State itself is directly responsible for the conformity assessment
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall take out liability insurance unless liability is assumed by the Member State in accordance with national law, or the Member State itself is directly responsible for the conformity assessment.

statements.subject: personnel of a conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall observe professional secrecy
statements.object_as_written: shall observe professional secrecy
statements.object_normalised: shall observe professional secrecy
statements.condition: except in relation to the competent authorities of the Member State in which its tasks are carried out
statements.quote: The personnel of a conformity assessment body shall observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out the conformity assessment tasks in accordance with Annexes VII, IX and X, except in relation to the competent authorities of the Member State in which its tasks are carried out.

statements.subject: Art. 30(10)
statements.object: proprietary rights, IP rights and trade secrets must be protected
statements.quote: Proprietary rights, intellectual property rights and trade secrets shall be protected.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of the relevant standardisation activities
statements.object_as_written: shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel
statements.object_normalised: shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of the relevant standardisation activities
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group.

statements.subject: conformity assessment body
statements.object: shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced by the coordination group
statements.object_as_written: shall apply as general guidance
statements.object_normalised: shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced by the coordination group
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group.

statements.subject: Art. 30(11)
statements.object: body is not an economic operator class
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group.

statements.subject: Art. 31
statements.object: Presumption of conformity for notified bodies via harmonised standards
statements.quote: Article 31 Presumption of conformity of notified bodies Where a conformity assessment body demonstrates its conformity with the criteria laid down in the relevant harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union , it shall be presumed to comply with the requirements set out in Article 30 insofar as the applicable harmonised standards cover those requirements.

statements.subject: Art. 32(1)
statements.object: notified body subcontracting and subsidiary duties, no matching relation
statements.quote: Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary, it shall ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements set out in Article 30 and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.

statements.subject: Art. 32(2)
statements.object: notified body responsibility for subcontractors not an economic operator
statements.quote: 2. A notified body shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by subcontractors or subsidiaries wherever those are established.

statements.subject: Art. 32(3)
statements.object: notified body subcontracting needs client agreement
statements.quote: Activities may be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the client.

statements.subject: Art. 32(4)
statements.object: Notified body must keep subcontractor documents; no retention duration stated
statements.quote: A notified body shall keep at the disposal of the notifying authority the relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under Annexes VII, IX and X.

statements.subject: Art. 33(1)
statements.object: Conformity assessment body duty to apply for notification; not an economic operator
statements.quote: A conformity assessment body shall submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which it is established.

statements.subject: Art. 33(2)
statements.object: application contents for notification body not covered by schema
statements.quote: 2. The application for notification shall be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, of the conformity assessment procedures set out in Annexes VII, IX and X and of the kinds or categories of machinery or related products for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent, as well as by an accreditation certificate, where one exists, issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 30.

statements.subject: Art. 33(3)
statements.object: Conformity assessment body is not an economic operator; documentary evidence duty
statements.quote: Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate as referred to in paragraph 2, it shall provide the notifying authority with all the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 30.

statements.subject: Art. 34(1)
statements.object: Notifying authority may notify only bodies meeting Article 30
statements.quote: A notifying authority shall notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 30.

statements.subject: Art. 34(2)
statements.object: notifying authority must notify Commission and Member States electronically
statements.quote: 2. The notifying authority shall send a notification to the Commission and the other Member States, using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission.

statements.subject: Art. 34(3)
statements.object: notification content list, no matching relation
statements.quote: (a) full details of the conformity assessment activities to be performed; (b) an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned; (c) the relevant attestation of competence.

statements.subject: Art. 34(4)
statements.object: notifying authority must give documentary evidence to Commission and Member States
statements.quote: Where a notification is not based on an accreditation certificate referred to in Article 33(2), the notifying authority shall provide the Commission and the other Member States with documentary evidence which attests to the conformity assessment body’s competence and the arrangements in place to ensure that that body will be monitored regularly and will continue to satisfy the requirements laid down in Article 30.

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: only such a body shall be considered a notified body
statements.object_as_written: Only such a body shall be considered a notified body
statements.object_normalised: only such a body shall be considered a notified body
statements.condition: for the purposes of this Regulation
statements.quote: Only such a body shall be considered a notified body for the purposes of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Art. 34(5)
statements.object: conformity body may act only if no objections within two weeks or two months
statements.quote: The conformity assessment body concerned may perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within two weeks of the validation of the notification where it includes an accreditation certificate referred to in Article 33(2), or within two months of the notification where it includes documentary evidence referred to in paragraph 4 of this Article.

statements.subject: Art. 34(6)
statements.object: notifying authority duty to report subsequent changes, not an economic operator
statements.quote: 6. The notifying authority shall notify the Commission and the other Member States of any subsequent relevant changes to the notification referred to in paragraph 2.

statements.subject: Art. 35(1)
statements.object: Commission assigns single identification number to notified body
statements.quote: The Commission shall assign an identification number to a notified body. It shall assign a single such number even where the body is notified under several Union acts.

statements.subject: Art. 35(2)
statements.object: Commission must publish and keep up to date the list of notified bodies
statements.quote: The Commission shall make publicly available the list of bodies notified under this Regulation including the identification numbers that have been assigned to them and the conformity assessment activities for which they have been notified. The Commission shall ensure that the list is kept up to date.

statements.subject: Art. 36(1)
statements.object: Notifying authority duty to restrict, suspend or withdraw notification
statements.quote: Where a notifying authority has ascertained or has been informed that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 30, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations as set out in Article 38 the notifying authority shall restrict, suspend or withdraw the notification, as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure to meet those requirements or fulfil those obligations. It shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.

statements.subject: Art. 36(2)
statements.object: Notifying authority must secure notified body files on restriction, suspension, withdrawal or cessation
statements.quote: In the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying authority shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that body are either processed by another notified body or kept available for the responsible notifying and market surveillance authorities at their request.

statements.subject: Art. 37(1)
statements.object: Commission must investigate doubts on notified body competence; no matching relation
statements.quote: Article 37 Challenge of the competence of notified bodies. 1. The Commission shall investigate all cases where it doubts, or doubt is brought to its attention regarding, the competence of a notified body or the continued fulfilment by a notified body of the requirements and responsibilities to which it is subject.

statements.subject: Art. 37(2)
statements.object: Member State must give Commission information on request; not an economic operator
statements.quote: 2. The notifying Member State shall provide the Commission, on request, with all information relating to the basis for the notification or the maintenance of the competence of the notified body concerned.

statements.subject: Art. 37(3)
statements.object: Commission must treat sensitive investigation information as confidential
statements.quote: The Commission shall ensure that all sensitive information obtained in the course of its investigations is treated confidentially.

statements.subject: Art. 37(4)
statements.object: Commission implementing act requires Member State corrective measures; advisory procedure
statements.quote: Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification, it shall adopt an implementing act requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures, including the withdrawal of the notification if necessary. That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the advisory procedure referred to in Article 48(2).

statements.subject: Art. 38(1)
statements.object: notified body obligation; no matching relation for notified bodies
statements.quote: A notified body shall carry out conformity assessments in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures set out in Annexes VII, IX and X.

statements.subject: Art. 38(2)
statements.object: Notified body proportionality duty; not an economic operator
statements.quote: A notified body shall perform its activities in a proportionate manner, avoiding unnecessary burdens for economic operators, and taking due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which the undertaking operates, the structure of the undertaking, the degree of complexity of the technology in question and the mass or serial nature of the production process. In so doing, the notified body shall nevertheless respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required for the compliance of the machinery or related product with the requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.object_as_written: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.object_normalised: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.condition: Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Article 20 have not been met by a manufacturer
statements.quote: Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Article 20 have not been met by a manufacturer, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions and shall not issue an EU-type examination certificate, adopt a quality system approval decision or issue a unit verification certificate.

statements.subject: Art. 38(3)
statements.object: notified body must withhold certificates and approvals when requirements unmet
statements.quote: Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Article 20 have not been met by a manufacturer, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions and shall not issue an EU-type examination certificate, adopt a quality system approval decision or issue a unit verification certificate.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.object_as_written: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.object_normalised: take appropriate corrective actions
statements.condition: where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies
statements.quote: Where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, following the adoption of an approval decision, in accordance with Annex IX, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions and shall suspend or withdraw the approval decision, if necessary.

statements.subject: Art. 38(4)
statements.object: notified body must restrict, suspend or withdraw approval decisions if corrective actions fail
statements.quote: Where corrective actions are not taken or do not have the required effect, the notified body shall restrict, suspend or withdraw any approval decisions, as appropriate.

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: shall ensure that a transparent and accessible appeals procedure
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that a transparent and accessible appeals procedure
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that a transparent and accessible appeals procedure
statements.quote: Article 39 Appeals against decisions of notified bodies A notified body shall ensure that a transparent and accessible appeals procedure against its decisions is available.

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: shall inform the notifying authority
statements.object_as_written: shall inform the notifying authority
statements.object_normalised: shall inform the notifying authority
statements.quote: A notified body shall inform the notifying authority of the following:

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal
statements.object_as_written: any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal
statements.object_normalised: any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal
statements.quote: (a) any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of an EU type-examination certificate, quality system approval decision or unit verification certificate;

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: any circumstances affecting the scope of
statements.object_as_written: any circumstances affecting the scope of
statements.object_normalised: any circumstances affecting the scope of
statements.quote: (b) any circumstances affecting the scope of, or the conditions for, its notification;

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: any request for information
statements.object_as_written: any request for information
statements.object_normalised: any request for information
statements.quote: (c) any request for information which it has received from market surveillance authorities regarding its conformity assessment activities;

statements.subject: notified body
statements.object: any conformity assessment activities
statements.object_as_written: any conformity assessment activities
statements.object_normalised: any conformity assessment activities
statements.condition: on request
statements.quote: (d) on request, any conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of its notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.

statements.subject: Art. 40(2)
statements.object: Notified body must inform peer notified bodies on negative and, on request, positive results
statements.quote: A notified body shall provide the other bodies notified under this Regulation carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same kinds of machinery or related products with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.

statements.subject: Art. 42
statements.object: Notified bodies must participate in the coordination group; no relation fits
statements.quote: Article 42 Coordination of notified bodies The Commission shall ensure the establishment and good functioning of appropriate coordination and cooperation between bodies notified under this Regulation in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies. Notified bodies shall participate in the work of that group, directly or by means of designated representatives.

statements.subject: relevant economic operators
statements.object: shall cooperate as necessary
statements.object_as_written: shall cooperate as necessary
statements.object_normalised: shall cooperate as necessary
statements.condition: for that purpose
statements.quote: The relevant economic operators shall cooperate as necessary with the market surveillance authorities for that purpose.

statements.subject: relevant economic operator
statements.object: take appropriate and proportionate corrective action
statements.object_as_written: take appropriate and proportionate corrective action
statements.object_normalised: take appropriate and proportionate corrective action
statements.condition: the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this Regulation
statements.quote: Where, in the course of the evaluation referred to in the first subparagraph, the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this Regulation, they shall without delay require the relevant economic operator to take appropriate and proportionate corrective action, as provided for in Article 16(3) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, to bring the non-compliance to an end or to eliminate hazards or, if that is not possible, minimise the risk specified by the market surveillance authorities within a reasonable period which is commensurate with the nature of the risk referred to in the first subparagraph.

statements.subject: Art. 43(1)
statements.object: corrective action deadline: reasonable period commensurate with risk, no fixed time
statements.quote: Where, in the course of the evaluation referred to in the first subparagraph, the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this Regulation, they shall without delay require the relevant economic operator to take appropriate and proportionate corrective action, as provided for in Article 16(3) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, to bring the non-compliance to an end or to eliminate hazards or, if that is not possible, minimise the risk specified by the market surveillance authorities within a reasonable period which is commensurate with the nature of the risk referred to in the first subparagraph.

statements.subject: Art. 43(2)
statements.object: Market surveillance authorities must inform Commission and other Member States
statements.quote: Where the market surveillance authorities consider that non-compliance is not restricted to their national territory, they shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which they have required the economic operator to take.

statements.subject: economic operator, products it made available on the market
statements.object: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.quote: The economic operator shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union.

statements.subject: Art. 43(4)
statements.object: Market surveillance authority duties to withdraw, recall or inform
statements.quote: Where the relevant economic operator does not take the corrective action referred to in paragraph 1, second subparagraph, within the specified period or where the non-compliance, referred to in paragraph 1, second subparagraph, or the risk referred to in paragraph 1, first subparagraph, persists, the market surveillance authorities shall ensure that the product concerned is withdrawn or recalled, or that making it available on the market is prohibited or restricted. In such cases, the market surveillance authorities shall ensure that the public, the Commission and the other Member States are informed accordingly, without delay.

statements.subject: Art. 43(5)
statements.object: authority notice must state whether non-compliance is due to listed causes
statements.quote: The information referred to in paragraph 4 shall include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the non-compliant product within the scope of this Regulation, the origin of that product, the nature of the non-compliance alleged and the risk involved, the nature and duration of the national measures taken and the arguments put forward by the relevant economic operator. In particular, the market surveillance authorities shall indicate whether the non-compliance is due to any of the following: (a) the failure of the product to meet the requirements relating to the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III;

statements.subject: Art. 43(6)
statements.object: Member States must inform Commission and others of measures without delay
statements.quote: Member States other than the Member State initiating the procedure under this Article shall without delay inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted and of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned, and, in the event of disagreement with the adopted national measure, of their objections.

statements.subject: Art. 43(7)
statements.object: Provisional measure deemed justified if no objection within three months
statements.quote: Where, within three months of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 4, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of a provisional measure taken by a Member State, that measure shall be deemed to be justified.

statements.subject: Art. 43(8)
statements.object: Member States must ensure restrictive measures without delay; not an operator obligation
statements.quote: Member States shall ensure that appropriate restrictive measures, such as withdrawal of the product, are taken in respect of the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned without delay.

statements.subject: Art. 44(1)
statements.object: Commission safeguard duties, no matching relation
statements.quote: Where, on completion of the procedure set out in Article 43(4), (6) and (7) objections are raised against a measure taken by a Member State, or where the Commission considers a national measure to be contrary to Union legal acts, the Commission shall without delay enter into consultation with the Member States and the relevant economic operator or operators and shall evaluate the national measure. On the basis of the results of that evaluation, the Commission shall adopt an implementing act in the form of a decision determining whether the national measure is justified or not. The Commission shall address its decision to all Member States and shall without delay communicate it to them and to the relevant economic operator or operators.

statements.subject: Art. 44(2)
statements.object: Member States must take restrictive measures if the national measure is justified
statements.quote: If the national measure is considered to be justified, all Member States shall ensure that appropriate restrictive measures, such as withdrawal, are taken in respect of the non-compliant product within the scope of this Regulation, and shall inform the Commission accordingly. If the national measure is considered to be unjustified, the Member State concerned shall withdraw that measure.

statements.subject: Art. 44(3)
statements.object: Commission must apply a standards or specifications procedure if shortcomings are found
statements.quote: Where the national measure is considered to be justified and the non-compliance of the product within the scope of this Regulation is attributed to shortcomings in the harmonised standards referred to in Article 43(5), point (b), of this Regulation or common specifications referred to in Article 43(5), point (c), of this Regulation, the Commission shall apply the procedure provided for in Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 or in Article 20(8) of this Regulation respectively.

statements.subject: relevant economic operator
statements.object: take all appropriate measures
statements.object_as_written: take all appropriate measures
statements.object_normalised: take all appropriate measures
statements.condition: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds
statements.quote: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds that although a product within the scope of this Regulation is in compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, it presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or to property, and, where applicable, to the environment, it shall require the relevant economic operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the product concerned, when placed on the market, no longer presents that risk, to withdraw that product or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk.

statements.subject: relevant economic operator
statements.object: to withdraw that product or to recall it
statements.object_as_written: to withdraw that product or to recall it
statements.object_normalised: to withdraw that product or to recall it
statements.condition: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds
statements.quote: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds that although a product within the scope of this Regulation is in compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, it presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or to property, and, where applicable, to the environment, it shall require the relevant economic operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the product concerned, when placed on the market, no longer presents that risk, to withdraw that product or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk.

statements.subject: Art. 45(1)
statements.object: recall period is only "reasonable", no fixed duration
statements.quote: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds that although a product within the scope of this Regulation is in compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, it presents a risk to the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or to property, and, where applicable, to the environment, it shall require the relevant economic operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the product concerned, when placed on the market, no longer presents that risk, to withdraw that product or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk.

statements.subject: economic operator
statements.object: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken
statements.condition: the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union
statements.quote: The economic operator shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of all the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union.

statements.subject: Art. 45(3)
statements.object: Member State must immediately notify Commission and other Member States of risky products
statements.quote: The Member State shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States about the product which presents a risk, as referred to in paragraph 1. That information shall include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the product concerned, the origin and the supply chain of that product, the nature of the risk involved and the nature and duration of the national measures taken.

statements.subject: Art. 45(5)
statements.object: Commission decision addressed to Member States and operators
statements.quote: The Commission shall address its decision to all Member States and shall immediately communicate it to them and to the relevant economic operator or operators.

statements.subject: relevant economic operator
statements.object: to put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.object_as_written: to put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.object_normalised: to put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.condition: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product
statements.quote: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product, it shall require the relevant economic operator to put an end to the non-compliance concerned:

statements.subject: relevant economic operator
statements.object: put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.object_as_written: put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.object_normalised: put an end to the non-compliance concerned
statements.condition: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery
statements.quote: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery, it shall require the relevant economic operator to put an end to the non-compliance concerned:

statements.subject: Art. 46(3)
statements.object: Member State obligation to restrict, prohibit, recall or withdraw non-compliant product; no matching relation
statements.quote: Where the non-compliance referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 persists, the Member State concerned shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned being made available on the market or ensure that it is recalled or withdrawn from the market.

statements.subject: Art. 47(1)
statements.object: Power to adopt delegated acts conferred on Commission, subject to conditions
statements.quote: The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.

statements.subject: power to adopt delegated acts
statements.object_as_written: 13 July 2023
statements.condition: for a period of five years
statements.quote: The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Articles 6(2), 6(11) and 7(2) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 13 July 2023.

statements.subject: Art. 47(2)
statements.object: Commission report due nine months before period ends
statements.quote: The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period.

statements.subject: Art. 47(2)
statements.object: Tacit extension unless Parliament or Council opposes three months before
statements.quote: The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.

statements.subject: decision to revoke delegation
statements.object: the day following the publication
statements.object_as_written: the day following the publication
statements.object_normalised: the day following the publication
statements.condition: or at a later date specified therein
statements.quote: It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the Official Journal of the European Union or at a later date specified therein.

statements.subject: Art. 47(4)
statements.object: Commission must consult member state experts before adopting delegated acts
statements.quote: Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making.

statements.subject: Art. 47(5)
statements.object: Commission must notify delegated acts to Parliament and Council
statements.quote: As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.

statements.subject: Art. 47(6)
statements.object: two-month objection period for delegated acts, extendable by two months
statements.quote: A delegated act adopted pursuant to Articles 6(2), 6(11) or 7(2) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or by the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.

statements.subject: Art. 48(1)
statements.object: Commission assisted by committee under Regulation 182/2011
statements.quote: The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011.

statements.subject: Art. 48(2)
statements.object: Committee procedure: Article 4 of Regulation 182/2011 applies where referenced
statements.quote: 2. Where reference is made to this paragraph, Article 4 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 shall apply.

statements.object: Committee consultation and examination role; no schema relation applies
statements.quote: The committee shall be consulted by the Commission on any matter for which consultation of sectoral experts is required by Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 or by any other Union legal act. The committee may furthermore examine any other matter concerning the application of this Regulation raised either by its chair or by a representative of a Member State in accordance with its rules of procedure.

statements.subject: Art. 49(1)
statements.object: Confidentiality duty binds all parties, not only economic operators
statements.quote: All parties shall respect the confidentiality of the following information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks in accordance with this Regulation: (a) personal data; (b) commercially confidential information and trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including intellectual property rights, unless disclosure is in the public interest.

statements.subject: Art. 49(2)
statements.object: Confidential information between authorities: no disclosure without originating authority's prior agreement
statements.quote: Without prejudice to paragraph 1, information exchanged on a confidential basis between the competent national authorities and between competent national authorities and the Commission shall not be disclosed without the prior agreement of the competent national authority that originally provided the information.

statements.subject: Art. 49(3)
statements.object: Confidentiality carve-out for Commission, Member States, notified bodies
statements.quote: Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, nor shall it affect the obligations of the persons concerned to provide information under criminal law.

statements.subject: Art. 49(4)
statements.object: Confidential information exchange with third-country regulators, conditional on agreements
statements.quote: The Commission and Member States may exchange confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries with which they have bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements when those agreements and arrangements ensure that any exchange of information is in accordance with applicable Union law.

statements.subject: Art. 50(1)
statements.object: Member States' duty to set penalties for operators' infringements
statements.quote: Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive and may include criminal penalties for serious infringements.

statements.subject: Art. 50(2)
statements.object: Member States notify Commission of penalty rules by deadline
statements.quote: Member States shall, by 14 October 2026, notify the Commission of those rules and of those measures and shall notify it, without delay, of any subsequent amendment affecting them.

statements.object_normalised: discomfort, fatigue and physical and psychological stress
statements.condition: Under the intended conditions of use
statements.quote: Ergonomics Under the intended conditions of use, the discomfort, fatigue and physical and psychological stress faced by the operator shall be eliminated or reduced to the minimum possible, taking into account at least, the following ergonomic principles:

statements.subject: human-machine interface

statements.object_as_written: adapting the human-machine interface

statements.quote: (f) adapting the human-machine interface to the foreseeable characteristics of the operators, including with respect to machinery or a related product with intended fully or partially self-evolving behaviour or logic that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy;

statements.subject: operating position 1.1.7

statements.subject: operating position cabin

statements.object_normalised: reduce the vibrations transmitted to the operator

statements.object_normalised: footrests covered with a slip-resistant material

statements.object_normalised: adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption

statements.object_normalised: collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention

statements.object_normalised: collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention

statements.quote: (f) the tracing log of the data generated in relation to an intervention and of the versions of safety software uploaded after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service is enabled for five years after such upload, exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority.

statements.subject: control system

statements.object_normalised: an acoustic and/or visual warning signal shall be given

statements.object_normalised: fitted with indicators

statements.object_normalised: subject to confirmation

statements.object_normalised: hazardous situation

statements.quote: For the machinery or related product functioning in automatic mode, the starting of the machinery or related product, restarting after a stoppage, or a change in operating conditions may be possible without intervention, provided this does not lead to a hazardous situation.

statements.object_normalised: other protective measures designed and constructed to ensure a safe intervention zone

statements.object_normalised: risk of slipping, tripping or falling
statements.quote: Risk of slipping, tripping or falling Parts of the machinery or related product where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling on or off these parts.

statements.object_as_written: prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling
statements.object_normalised: prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling
statements.condition: where persons are liable to move about or stand
statements.quote: Risk of slipping, tripping or falling Parts of the machinery or related product where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling on or off these parts.

statements.object_normalised: handholds that are fixed relative to the user

statements.subject: machinery in need of protection against lightning

statements.object_as_written: a system for conducting the resultant electrical charge to earth
statements.object_normalised: a system for conducting the resultant electrical charge to earth
statements.condition: in need of protection against the effects of lightning while being used
statements.quote: Lightning Machinery or related products in need of protection against the effects of lightning while being used shall be fitted with a system for conducting the resultant electrical charge to earth.

statements.subject: adjustment and maintenance points
statements.object: located outside danger zones
statements.object_as_written: located outside danger zones
statements.object_normalised: located outside danger zones
statements.quote: Machinery or related product maintenance Adjustment and maintenance points shall be located outside danger zones.

statements.subject: adjustment, maintenance, repair, cleaning and servicing operations

statements.object_as_written: at a standstill
statements.object_normalised: at a standstill

statements.subject: operations that cannot be done at standstill
statements.object: measures shall be taken
statements.object_as_written: measures shall be taken
statements.object_normalised: measures shall be taken
statements.condition: If one or more of the above conditions cannot be satisfied for technical reasons

statements.subject: diagnostic fault-finding equipment
statements.object: a connecting device
statements.object_as_written: a connecting device
statements.object_normalised: a connecting device
statements.condition: In the case of automated machinery and, where necessary, other machinery or related products

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.6.1

statements.quote: Automated machinery or related product components, which have to be changed frequently, shall be capable of being removed and replaced easily and safely.

statements.subject: machinery accesses for persons entering machinery

statements.object_as_written: dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment
statements.object_normalised: dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment
statements.condition: In the case of machinery or related products into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning
statements.quote: In the case of machinery or related products into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning, the machinery accesses shall be dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment in such a way that an emergency rescue of the persons is possible.

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.6.2
statements.object: design for safe access to all intervention areas, no matching relation
statements.quote: Access to operating positions and servicing points Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow access in safety to all areas where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment, maintenance and cleaning of the machinery or related product.

statements.subject: machinery isolation from energy sources
statements.object: means to isolate it from all energy sources
statements.object_as_written: means to isolate it from all energy sources
statements.object_normalised: means to isolate it from all energy sources
statements.quote: Isolation of energy sources Machinery or related products shall be fitted with means to isolate it from all energy sources.

statements.subject: isolators
statements.object: capable of being locked
statements.object_as_written: capable of being locked
statements.object_normalised: capable of being locked
statements.condition: if reconnection could endanger persons
statements.quote: They shall be capable of being locked if reconnection could endanger persons.

statements.subject: isolators
statements.object: capable of being locked
statements.object_as_written: capable of being locked
statements.object_normalised: capable of being locked
statements.condition: where an operator is unable to check that the energy is still cut off
statements.quote: Isolators shall also be capable of being locked where an operator is unable, from any of the points to which he or she has access, to check that the energy is still cut off.

statements.subject: plugged machinery

statements.object_as_written: removal of the plug is sufficient
statements.object_normalised: removal of the plug is sufficient
statements.condition: if the operator can check that the plug remains removed

statements.subject: energy remaining or stored in circuits

statements.object_as_written: dissipate normally
statements.object_normalised: dissipate normally
statements.condition: after the energy is cut off
statements.quote: After the energy is cut off, it shall be possible to dissipate normally any energy remaining or stored in the circuits of the machinery or related product without risk to persons.

statements.subject: circuits kept connected to energy sources

statements.object_as_written: special steps shall be taken to ensure operator safety
statements.object_normalised: special steps shall be taken to ensure operator safety
statements.condition: certain circuits may remain connected to their energy sources
statements.quote: As an exception to the requirement laid down in the previous paragraphs, certain circuits may remain connected to their energy sources in order, for example, to hold parts, to protect information, to light interiors, etc. In this case, special steps shall be taken to ensure operator safety.

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.6.3
statements.object: isolators must be clearly identified; no relation fits
statements.quote: Such isolators shall be clearly identified.

statements.object_normalised: possible to clean internal parts without entering
statements.condition: which have contained dangerous substances or mixtures

statements.subject: necessary unblocking of internal parts
statements.object: possible from the outside
statements.object_as_written: possible from the outside
statements.object_normalised: possible from the outside
statements.quote: any necessary unblocking shall also be possible from the outside.

statements.subject: cleaning where entering cannot be avoided

statements.object_normalised: designed to allow cleaning to take place safely
statements.condition: If it is impossible to avoid entering the machinery or related product
statements.quote: If it is impossible to avoid entering the machinery or related product, it shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow cleaning to take place safely.

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.7.1

statements.quote: Information and warnings on the machinery or related product Information and warnings on the machinery or related product shall preferably be provided in the form of readily understandable symbols or pictograms. statements.subject: Annex III, 1.7.1.1
statements.object: essential requirement on control information and display clarity has no schema relation
statements.quote: Information and information devices The information needed to control machinery or a related product shall be provided in a form that is unambiguous and easily understood. It shall not be excessive to the extent of overloading the operator. Visual display units or any other interactive means of communication between the operator and the machinery or related product shall be easily understood and easy to use.

statements.subject: warning devices

statements.object_as_written: appropriate acoustic or light signal
statements.object_normalised: appropriate acoustic or light signal
statements.condition: Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery or a related product
statements.quote: Warning devices Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery or a related product, the machinery or related product shall be equipped in such a way as to give an appropriate acoustic or light signal as a warning.

statements.subject: operator

statements.object_as_written: have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times
statements.object_normalised: have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.7.1.2

statements.quote: Where machinery or a related product is equipped with warning devices, these shall be unambiguous and easily perceived.

statements.object_normalised: the necessary warnings, including warning devices
statements.condition: Where risks remain despite the inherent safe design measures, safeguarding and complementary protective measures adopted
statements.quote: Warning of residual risks Where risks remain despite the inherent safe design measures, safeguarding and complementary protective measures adopted, the necessary warnings, including warning devices, shall be provided.

statements.object_as_written: risks remain
statements.object_normalised: residual risks

statements.quote: Warning of residual risks Where risks remain despite the inherent safe design measures, safeguarding and complementary protective measures adopted, the necessary warnings, including warning devices, shall be provided.

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.7.3
statements.object: Visible, legible, indelible marking of machinery; no relation

statements.subject: manufacturer or its authorised representative

statements.object_normalised: may be supplied in only one official language of the union

statements.quote: By way of exception to Article 10(7), the maintenance instructions intended for use by specialised personnel mandated by the manufacturer or its authorised representative may be supplied in only one official language of the Union which the specialised personnel understand.

statements.object: instructions-for-use duty names no economic operator

statements.object_as_written: shall cover not only the intended use

statements.object_as_written: shall take into account the level of general education and acumen
statements.object_normalised: shall take into account the level of general education and acumen
statements.condition: In the case of machinery or related products intended for use by non-professional operators
statements.quote: (b) In the case of machinery or related products intended for use by non-professional operators, the wording and layout of the instructions for use shall take into account the level of general education and acumen that can reasonably be expected from such operators.

statements.subject: Annex III, 1.7.4.1
statements.object: obligated economic operator not named in passage
statements.quote: General principles for the drafting of instructions for use (a) The contents of the instructions for use shall cover not only the intended use of the machinery or related product but also take into account any reasonably foreseeable misuse thereof; (b) In the case of machinery or related products intended for use by non-professional operators, the wording and layout of the instructions for use shall take into account the level of general education and acumen that can reasonably be expected from such operators.

statements.subject: Annex III, 2
statements.object: scope: listed categories must meet all essential requirements of this chapter
statements.quote: SUPPLEMENTARY ESSENTIAL HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN CATEGORIES OF MACHINERY AND RELATED PRODUCTS Machinery and related products for foodstuffs, machinery and related products for cosmetics or pharmaceutical products, portable hand-held or hand-guided machinery and related products, portable fixing and other impact machinery and related products, machinery and related products for working wood and material with similar physical characteristics and machinery and related products for plant protection products application shall meet all the essential health and safety requirements set out in this chapter (see General Principles, point 4).

statements.object_normalised: risk of infection, sickness or contagion

statements.object_as_written: disposable parts shall be used
statements.object_normalised: disposable parts shall be used

statements.object_normalised: be easily cleaned and disinfected

statements.object_normalised: completely discharged

statements.object_normalised: no ancillary substances hazardous to health

statements.subject: Annex III, 2.1.1
