statements.object_normalised: appropriate protective structure
statements.condition: if its size allows
statements.quote: Falling objects Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material, the machinery shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk and fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_as_written: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_normalised: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.condition: for each type of structure concerned
statements.quote: In order to verify that the structure complies with the requirement laid down in the second paragraph, the manufacturer shall, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.4.4
statements.object: structure must guarantee adequate deflection-limiting volume for ride-on persons
statements.quote: This structure shall be such that, in the event of falling objects or material, it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume.

statements.subject: means of access
statements.object: handholds and steps
statements.object_as_written: Handholds and steps
statements.object_normalised: handholds and steps
statements.quote: Means of access Handholds and steps shall be designed, constructed and arranged in such a way that the operators use them instinctively and do not use the control devices to assist access.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.4.5
statements.object: operators must not use control devices to assist access
statements.quote: Means of access Handholds and steps shall be designed, constructed and arranged in such a way that the operators use them instinctively and do not use the control devices to assist access.

statements.subject: machinery used to tow or be towed
statements.object: towing or coupling devices
statements.object_as_written: towing or coupling devices
statements.object_normalised: towing or coupling devices
statements.quote: Towing devices All machinery used to tow or to be towed shall be fitted with towing or coupling devices designed, constructed and arranged in such a way as to ensure easy and secure connection and disconnection and to prevent accidental disconnection during use.

statements.subject: machinery subject to tow bar load
statements.object: a support with a bearing surface
statements.object_as_written: a support with a bearing surface
statements.object_normalised: a support with a bearing surface
statements.condition: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires
statements.quote: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires, such machinery shall be equipped with a support with a bearing surface suited to the load and the ground.

statements.subject: power take-off on self-propelled machinery (or tractor)
statements.object: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery
statements.object_as_written: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery
statements.object_normalised: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery
statements.condition: or by any other device offering equivalent protection
statements.quote: On the side of the self-propelled machinery (or the tractor), the power take-off to which the removable mechanical transmission device is attached shall be protected either by a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery (or the tractor) or by any other device offering equivalent protection.

statements.subject: removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object: protected over its whole length
statements.object_as_written: protected over its whole length
statements.object_normalised: protected over its whole length
statements.condition: any part that moves during operation
statements.quote: Transmission of power between self-propelled machinery (or a tractor) and recipient machinery Removable mechanical transmission devices linking self-propelled machinery (or a tractor) to the first fixed bearing of recipient machinery shall be designed and constructed in such a way that any part that moves during operation is protected over its whole length.

statements.subject: input shaft on recipient machinery
statements.object: enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery
statements.object_as_written: enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery
statements.object_normalised: enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery
statements.quote: On the recipient machinery side, the input shaft shall be enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery.

statements.subject: guard of the power take-off
statements.object: possible to open this guard
statements.object_as_written: possible to open this guard
statements.object_normalised: possible to open this guard
statements.condition: for access to the removable transmission device
statements.quote: It shall be possible to open this guard for access to the removable transmission device.

statements.subject: recipient machinery attaching system
statements.object: a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object_as_written: a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object_normalised: a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.condition: when the machinery is uncoupled
statements.quote: All recipient machinery the operation of which requires a removable mechanical transmission device to connect it to self-propelled machinery (or a tractor) shall have a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device so that, when the machinery is uncoupled, the removable mechanical transmission device and its guard are not damaged by contact with the ground or part of the machinery.

statements.subject: guard coverage, simple universal joints
statements.object: cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws
statements.object_as_written: cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws
statements.object_normalised: cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws
statements.condition: in the case of simple universal joints
statements.quote: The guard shall cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws in the case of simple universal joints and at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints in the case of wide-angle universal joints.

statements.subject: guard coverage, wide-angle universal joints
statements.object: at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints
statements.object_as_written: at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints
statements.object_normalised: at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints
statements.condition: in the case of wide-angle universal joints
statements.quote: The guard shall cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws in the case of simple universal joints and at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints in the case of wide-angle universal joints.

statements.subject: guard clearance for drive shaft
statements.object: enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard
statements.object_as_written: enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard
statements.object_normalised: enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard
statements.condition: once it is in place
statements.quote: Once it is in place, there shall be enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard when the machinery (or the tractor) is moving.

statements.subject: shaft guards used as access means
statements.object: cannot be used as steps
statements.object_as_written: cannot be used as steps
statements.object_normalised: cannot be used as steps
statements.condition: unless designed and constructed for that purpose
statements.quote: If means of access to working positions are provided near to the removable mechanical transmission device, they shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the shaft guards cannot be used as steps, unless designed and constructed for that purpose.

statements.subject: removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object: marked accordingly
statements.object_as_written: marked accordingly
statements.object_normalised: marked accordingly
statements.quote: The removable mechanical transmission device shall be marked accordingly.

statements.subject: outside parts of the guard
statements.object: cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object_as_written: cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.object_normalised: cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device
statements.quote: The outside parts of the guard shall be so designed, constructed and arranged that they cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.4.7
statements.object: torque limiters or freewheels permitted only on driven-machinery side
statements.quote: Torque limiters or freewheels may be fitted to universal joint transmissions only on the side adjoining the driven machinery.

statements.subject: battery housing
statements.object: electrolyte being ejected on to the operator
statements.object_as_written: electrolyte being ejected on to the operator
statements.object_normalised: electrolyte being ejected on to the operator
statements.condition: in the event of rollover or tip over
statements.quote: Batteries The battery housing shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent the electrolyte being ejected on to the operator in the event of rollover or tip over and to avoid the accumulation of vapours in places occupied by operators.

statements.subject: battery housing
statements.object: accumulation of vapours
statements.object_as_written: accumulation of vapours
statements.object_normalised: accumulation of vapours
statements.condition: in places occupied by operators
statements.quote: Batteries The battery housing shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent the electrolyte being ejected on to the operator in the event of rollover or tip over and to avoid the accumulation of vapours in places occupied by operators.

statements.subject: battery disconnection
statements.object: easily accessible device provided for that purpose
statements.object_as_written: easily accessible device provided for that purpose
statements.object_normalised: easily accessible device provided for that purpose
statements.quote: Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the battery can be disconnected with the aid of an easily accessible device provided for that purpose.

statements.subject: automatic-charging batteries of mobile machinery
statements.object: hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1
statements.object_as_written: hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1
statements.object_normalised: hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1
statements.condition: when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station
statements.quote: The batteries with automatic charging for mobile machinery or related products, including autonomous mobile machinery or related products, shall be designed to prevent hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1, including the risks of contact or collision of the machinery or related product with a person or other machinery or related products when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station.

statements.subject: fire protection, easily accessible fire extinguishers
statements.object: easily accessible fire extinguishers
statements.object_as_written: easily accessible fire extinguishers
statements.object_normalised: easily accessible fire extinguishers
statements.condition: where its size permits
statements.quote: Fire Depending on the hazards anticipated by the manufacturer, machinery shall, where its size permits: (a) either allow easily accessible fire extinguishers to be fitted; or (b) be provided with built-in extinguisher systems.

statements.subject: fire protection, built-in extinguisher systems
statements.object: built-in extinguisher systems
statements.object_as_written: built-in extinguisher systems
statements.object_normalised: built-in extinguisher systems
statements.condition: where its size permits
statements.quote: Fire Depending on the hazards anticipated by the manufacturer, machinery shall, where its size permits: (a) either allow easily accessible fire extinguishers to be fitted; or (b) be provided with built-in extinguisher systems.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.5.2
statements.object: need for measures depends on manufacturer's anticipated hazards
statements.quote: Fire Depending on the hazards anticipated by the manufacturer, machinery shall, where its size permits:

statements.subject: ride-on mobile machinery applying hazardous substances
statements.object: filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures
statements.object_as_written: filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures
statements.object_normalised: filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures
statements.condition: Ride-on mobile machinery having application of hazardous substances as the main function
statements.quote: Ride-on mobile machinery having application of hazardous substances as the main function shall be equipped with filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.5.3
statements.object: Section 1.5.13 paragraphs 2-3 disapplied for hazardous substance application
statements.quote: Emissions of hazardous substances The second and third paragraphs of section 1.5.13 do not apply where the main function of the machinery is the application of hazardous substances.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.5.4
statements.object: risk of contact with live overhead power lines
statements.object_as_written: Risk of contact with live overhead power lines
statements.object_normalised: risk of contact with live overhead power lines
statements.condition: where relevant
statements.quote: Risk of contact with live overhead power lines Depending on their height, mobile machinery or related products shall, where relevant, be designed, constructed and equipped, so as to prevent the risk of contact with an energised overhead power line or the risk of creating an electric arc between any part of the machinery or an operator driving the machinery and an energised overhead power line.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.5.4
statements.object: designed, constructed and equipped, so as to prevent the risk of contact
statements.object_as_written: designed, constructed and equipped, so as to prevent the risk of contact
statements.object_normalised: designed, constructed and equipped, so as to prevent the risk of contact
statements.condition: where relevant
statements.quote: Risk of contact with live overhead power lines Depending on their height, mobile machinery or related products shall, where relevant, be designed, constructed and equipped, so as to prevent the risk of contact with an energised overhead power line or the risk of creating an electric arc between any part of the machinery or an operator driving the machinery and an energised overhead power line.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.5.4 (mobile machinery, second paragraph)
statements.object: prevent any electrical hazards
statements.object_as_written: prevent any electrical hazards
statements.object_normalised: prevent any electrical hazards
statements.condition: When the risk to the persons operating machinery incurred by the contact with an energised overhead power line cannot be fully avoided
statements.quote: When the risk to the persons operating machinery incurred by the contact with an energised overhead power line cannot be fully avoided, mobile machinery or related products shall be designed, constructed and equipped so as to prevent any electrical hazards.

statements.subject: machinery and related products
statements.object: signs and/or instruction plates
statements.object_as_written: signs and/or instruction plates
statements.object_normalised: signs and/or instruction plates
statements.condition: wherever necessary
statements.quote: Signs, signals and warnings All machinery or related products shall have signs and/or instruction plates concerning use, adjustment and maintenance, wherever necessary, so as to ensure the health and safety of persons.

statements.subject: ride-on driver machinery
statements.object: an acoustic warning device
statements.object_as_written: an acoustic warning device
statements.object_normalised: an acoustic warning device
statements.condition: without prejudice to the provisions of road traffic regulations
statements.quote: Without prejudice to the provisions of road traffic regulations, machinery or related products with a ride-on driver shall have the following equipment: (a) an acoustic warning device to alert persons;

statements.subject: ride-on driver machinery
statements.object: a system of light signals
statements.object_as_written: a system of light signals
statements.object_normalised: a system of light signals
statements.condition: the latter requirement does not apply to machinery or related products intended solely for underground working and having no electrical power
statements.quote: (b) a system of light signals relevant to the intended conditions of use; the latter requirement does not apply to machinery or related products intended solely for underground working and having no electrical power;

statements.subject: machinery connected to a trailer
statements.object: an appropriate connection between a trailer and the machinery
statements.object_as_written: an appropriate connection between a trailer and the machinery
statements.object_normalised: an appropriate connection between a trailer and the machinery
statements.condition: where necessary
statements.quote: (c) where necessary, there shall be an appropriate connection between a trailer and the machinery or a related product for the operation of signals.

statements.subject: remote-controlled machinery
statements.object: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.object_as_written: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.object_normalised: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.condition: under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing
statements.quote: Remote-controlled machinery or related products which, under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing shall be fitted with appropriate means to signal its movements or with means to protect persons against such risks. The same shall apply to machinery or related products, which involves, when in use, the constant repetition of a forward and backward movement on a single axis where the area to the rear of the machinery is not directly visible to the driver.

statements.subject: machinery with constant forward and backward movement on a single axis
statements.object: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.object_as_written: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.object_normalised: appropriate means to signal its movements
statements.condition: where the area to the rear of the machinery is not directly visible to the driver
statements.quote: Remote-controlled machinery or related products which, under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing shall be fitted with appropriate means to signal its movements or with means to protect persons against such risks. The same shall apply to machinery or related products, which involves, when in use, the constant repetition of a forward and backward movement on a single axis where the area to the rear of the machinery is not directly visible to the driver.

statements.subject: warning and signalling devices
statements.object: the means to check that they are in good working order
statements.object_as_written: the means to check that they are in good working order
statements.object_normalised: the means to check that they are in good working order
statements.condition: where it is essential for safety
statements.quote: Where it is essential for safety, such devices shall be provided with the means to check that they are in good working order and their failure shall be made apparent to the operator.

statements.subject: machinery with hazardous movement of machinery or its tools
statements.object: signs on the machinery
statements.object_as_written: signs on the machinery
statements.object_normalised: signs on the machinery
statements.condition: where the movement of machinery or its tools is particularly hazardous
statements.quote: Where the movement of machinery or its tools is particularly hazardous, signs on the machinery shall be provided to warn against approaching the machinery while it is working; the signs shall be legible at a sufficient distance to ensure the safety of persons who have to be in the vicinity.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.6.1
statements.object: warning and signalling devices must not be disabled unintentionally
statements.quote: Machinery or related products shall be constructed in such a way that the warning and signalling devices cannot be disabled unintentionally.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.6.2
statements.object: marking of power, mass and drawbar data not in schema
statements.quote: Marking (1) (a) nominal power expressed in kilowatts (kW); (b) mass of the most usual configuration, in kilograms (kg). (2) (a) maximum drawbar pull provided for at the coupling hook, in Newtons (N);

statements.subject: machinery or related products
statements.object: instructions for use
statements.object_as_written: The instructions for use
statements.object_normalised: instructions for use
statements.quote: Vibrations The instructions for use shall give the following information concerning vibrations, expressed as acceleration (m/s 2 ), transmitted by the machinery or related products to the hand-arm system or to the whole body:

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.6.3.1
statements.object: operating conditions and measurement codes must be described
statements.quote: The operating conditions during measurement and the measurement codes used shall be described.

statements.subject: instructions for use for machinery allowing several uses
statements.object: instructions for use
statements.object_as_written: instructions for use
statements.object_normalised: instructions for use
statements.condition: allowing several uses depending on the equipment used
statements.quote: Multiple uses The instructions for use for machinery or a related product allowing several uses depending on the equipment used and the instructions for use for the interchangeable equipment shall contain the information necessary for safe assembly and use of the basic machinery or related product and the interchangeable equipment that can be fitted.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.6.3.2
statements.object: content must include information necessary for safe assembly and use
statements.quote: Multiple uses The instructions for use for machinery or a related product allowing several uses depending on the equipment used and the instructions for use for the interchangeable equipment shall contain the information necessary for safe assembly and use of the basic machinery or related product and the interchangeable equipment that can be fitted.

statements.subject: autonomous mobile machinery or related products
statements.object: instructions for use
statements.object_as_written: instructions for use
statements.object_normalised: instructions for use
statements.quote: Autonomous mobile machinery or related products The instructions for use of autonomous mobile machinery or related products shall specify the characteristics of its intended travel, working areas and danger zones.

statements.subject: Annex III, 3.6.3.3
statements.object: instructions must specify travel, working areas, danger zones
statements.quote: Autonomous mobile machinery or related products The instructions for use of autonomous mobile machinery or related products shall specify the characteristics of its intended travel, working areas and danger zones.

statements.subject: Annex III, 4
statements.object: machinery with lifting risks must meet all relevant chapter requirements
statements.quote: SUPPLEMENTARY ESSENTIAL HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS TO OFFSET RISKS DUE TO LIFTING OPERATIONS Machinery or related products presenting risks due to lifting operations shall meet all the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in this chapter (see General Principles, point 4).

statements.subject: Lifting operation
statements.object: a movement of unit loads
statements.object_as_written: a movement of unit loads
statements.object_normalised: a movement of unit loads
statements.quote: (a) ‘Lifting operation’ means a movement of unit loads consisting of goods and/or persons necessitating, at a given moment, a change of level;

statements.subject: Guided load
statements.object: a load where the total movement is made along rigid or flexible guides
statements.object_as_written: a load where the total movement is made along rigid or flexible guides
statements.object_normalised: a load where the total movement is made along rigid or flexible guides
statements.quote: (b) ‘Guided load’ means a load where the total movement is made along rigid or flexible guides whose position is determined by fixed points;

statements.subject: Working coefficient
statements.object: the arithmetic ratio between the load guaranteed by the manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: the arithmetic ratio between the load guaranteed by the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: the arithmetic ratio between the load guaranteed by the manufacturer
statements.quote: (c) ‘Working coefficient’ means the arithmetic ratio between the load guaranteed by the manufacturer up to which a component is able to hold it and the maximum working load marked on the component;

statements.subject: Test coefficient
statements.object: the arithmetic ratio between the load used to carry out the static or dynamic tests
statements.object_as_written: the arithmetic ratio between the load used to carry out the static or dynamic tests
statements.object_normalised: the arithmetic ratio between the load used to carry out the static or dynamic tests
statements.quote: (d) ‘Test coefficient’ means the arithmetic ratio between the load used to carry out the static or dynamic tests on the machinery or related product or lifting accessory and the maximum working load marked on the machinery or related product or lifting accessory;

statements.subject: Static test
statements.object: the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected
statements.object_as_written: the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected
statements.object_normalised: the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected
statements.quote: (e) ‘Static test’ means the test during which the machinery or related product or lifting accessory is first inspected and subjected to a force corresponding to the maximum working load multiplied by the appropriate static test coefficient and then re-inspected once the said load has been released to ensure that no damage has occurred;

statements.subject: Dynamic test
statements.object: the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations
statements.object_as_written: the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations
statements.object_normalised: the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations
statements.quote: (f) ‘Dynamic test’ means the test during which the machinery or related product is operated in all its possible configurations at the maximum working load multiplied by the appropriate dynamic test coefficient with account being taken of the dynamic behaviour of the lifting machinery in order to check that it functions properly;

statements.subject: Carrier
statements.object: a part of the machinery or related product on or in which persons and/or goods are supported
statements.object_as_written: a part of the machinery or related product on or in which persons and/or goods are supported
statements.object_normalised: a part of the machinery or related product on or in which persons and/or goods are supported
statements.quote: (g) ‘Carrier’ means a part of the machinery or related product on or in which persons and/or goods are supported in order to be lifted.

statements.subject: essential requirement 4.1.2.1
statements.object: risks due to lack of stability
statements.object_as_written: Risks due to lack of stability
statements.object_normalised: risks due to lack of stability
statements.quote: Risks due to lack of stability Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the stability required by section 1.3.1 is maintained both in service and out of service, including all stages of transportation, assembly and dismantling, during foreseeable component failures and also during the tests carried out in accordance with the instructions for use.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall use the appropriate verification methods
statements.object_as_written: shall use the appropriate verification methods
statements.object_normalised: shall use the appropriate verification methods
statements.quote: To that end, the manufacturer shall use the appropriate verification methods.

statements.subject: Annex III, 4.1.2.1
statements.object: stability duty cross-refers to section 1.3.1
statements.quote: Risks due to lack of stability Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the stability required by section 1.3.1 is maintained both in service and out of service, including all stages of transportation, assembly and dismantling, during foreseeable component failures and also during the tests carried out in accordance with the instructions for use.

statements.subject: 4.1.2.2 machinery running on guide rails
statements.object: devices, which act on the guide rails
statements.object_as_written: devices, which act on the guide rails
statements.object_normalised: devices, which act on the guide rails
statements.quote: Machinery or related products running on guide rails and rail tracks Machinery or related products shall be provided with devices, which act on the guide rails or tracks to prevent derailment.

statements.subject: 4.1.2.2 residual risk of derailment or rail failure
statements.object: devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment
statements.object_as_written: devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment
statements.object_normalised: devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment
statements.condition: If, despite such devices, there remains a risk of derailment or of failure of a rail or of a running component
statements.quote: If, despite such devices, there remains a risk of derailment or of failure of a rail or of a running component, devices shall be provided which prevent the equipment, component or load from falling or the machinery from overturning.

statements.subject: mechanical strength, fatigue and wear
statements.object: failure from fatigue and wear
statements.object_as_written: failure from fatigue and wear
statements.object_normalised: failure from fatigue and wear
statements.condition: taking due account of their intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse
statements.quote: Machinery or related products, including lifting accessories, shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent failure from fatigue and wear, taking due account of their intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse.

statements.subject: material choice, corrosion and abrasion
statements.object: corrosion, abrasion, impacts
statements.object_as_written: corrosion, abrasion, impacts
statements.object_normalised: corrosion, abrasion, impacts
statements.condition: on the basis of the intended working environments
statements.quote: The materials used shall be chosen on the basis of the intended working environments, with particular regard to corrosion, abrasion, impacts, extreme temperatures, fatigue, brittleness, radiation and ageing.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_as_written: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_normalised: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.condition: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained
statements.quote: In order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained, the manufacturer shall, for each type of chain and rope used directly for lifting the load and for the rope ends, perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

statements.subject: Annex III, 4.1.2.4
statements.object: general working coefficients: ropes 5, lifting chains 4
statements.quote: As a general rule, this coefficient is equal to 5. Lifting chains shall have a working coefficient chosen in such a way as to guarantee an adequate level of safety. As a general rule, this coefficient is equal to 4.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_as_written: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_normalised: perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.condition: in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained
statements.quote: (f) in order to verify that an adequate working coefficient has been attained, the manufacturer shall, for each type of component referred to in points (a) to (d), perform the appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

statements.subject: devices for controlling movements
statements.object: devices for controlling movements
statements.object_as_written: Devices for controlling movements
statements.object_normalised: devices for controlling movements
statements.quote: Control of movements Devices for controlling movements shall act in such a way that the machinery or related product on which they are installed is kept safe.

statements.subject: amplitude of movement of components
statements.object: fitted with devices
statements.object_as_written: fitted with devices
statements.object_normalised: fitted with devices
statements.quote: (a) Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed or fitted with devices in such a way that the amplitude of movement of its components is kept within the specified limits.

statements.subject: operation of such devices
statements.object: preceded by a warning
statements.object_as_written: preceded by a warning
statements.object_normalised: preceded by a warning
statements.condition: where appropriate
statements.quote: The operation of such devices shall, where appropriate, be preceded by a warning;

statements.subject: simultaneous manoeuvring with collision risk
statements.object: fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided
statements.object_as_written: fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided
statements.object_normalised: fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided
statements.condition: Where several fixed or rail-mounted machinery or related products can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision
statements.quote: (b) Where several fixed or rail-mounted machinery or related products can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision, such machinery shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to make it possible to fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided;

statements.subject: loads
statements.object: creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly
statements.object_as_written: creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly
statements.object_normalised: creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly
statements.condition: even in the event of partial or total failure of the power supply or when the operator stops operating the machinery
statements.quote: (c) Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that the loads cannot creep dangerously or fall freely and unexpectedly, even in the event of partial or total failure of the power supply or when the operator stops operating the machinery;

statements.subject: holding devices and loads
statements.object: inadvertent dropping of the loads
statements.object_as_written: inadvertent dropping of the loads
statements.object_normalised: inadvertent dropping of the loads
statements.quote: (e) Holding devices shall be designed and constructed in such a way that inadvertent dropping of the loads is avoided.

statements.subject: Annex III, 4.1.2.6
statements.object: lowering load by friction brake prohibited unless function requires
statements.quote: (d) It shall not be possible, under normal operating conditions, to lower the load solely by friction brake, except in the case of machinery or related products whose function requires it to operate in that way;

statements.subject: 4.1.2.7 movements of loads during handling
statements.object: possible collisions with persons
statements.object_as_written: possible collisions with persons
statements.object_normalised: possible collisions with persons
statements.condition: which might be manoeuvring at the same time and liable to constitute a hazard
statements.quote: Movements of loads during handling The operating position of machinery shall be located in such a way as to ensure the widest possible view of trajectories of the moving parts, in order to avoid possible collisions with persons, equipment or other machinery, which might be manoeuvring at the same time and liable to constitute a hazard.

statements.object_as_written: shall include at least the following elements
statements.object_normalised: shall include at least the following elements
statements.quote: The technical documentation shall include at least the following elements:

statements.subject: references of harmonised standards applied
statements.object: the references of the harmonised standards
statements.object_as_written: the references of the harmonised standards
statements.object_normalised: the references of the harmonised standards
statements.condition: that have been applied for the design and manufacture of the machinery or related product
statements.quote: (e) the references of the harmonised standards referred to in Article 20(1) or common specifications adopted by the Commission in accordance with Article 20(3) that have been applied for the design and manufacture of the machinery or related product.

statements.subject: partial application of harmonised standards
statements.object: the documentation shall specify the parts
statements.object_as_written: the documentation shall specify the parts
statements.object_normalised: the documentation shall specify the parts
statements.condition: in the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications
statements.quote: In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the documentation shall specify the parts, which have been applied;

statements.subject: residual risks
statements.object: the indication of the residual risks
statements.object_as_written: the indication of the residual risks
statements.object_normalised: the indication of the residual risks
statements.condition: when appropriate
statements.quote: (ii) the description of the protective measures implemented to meet each applicable essential health and safety requirement and, when appropriate, the indication of the residual risks associated with the machinery or related product;

statements.subject: source code or programming logic of safety related software
statements.object: source code or programming logic
statements.object_as_written: source code or programming logic
statements.object_normalised: source code or programming logic
statements.condition: further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority provided that is necessary
statements.quote: (m) the source code or programming logic of the safety related software to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Regulation further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority provided that is necessary in order for those authorities to be able to check compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III;

statements.subject: internal measures for series production
statements.object: the internal measures that will be implemented
statements.object_as_written: the internal measures that will be implemented
statements.object_normalised: the internal measures that will be implemented
statements.condition: for machinery or related products produced in series
statements.quote: (l) for machinery or related products produced in series, the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the machinery or related product remains in conformity with this Regulation;

statements.subject: copy of instructions for use
statements.object: a copy of the instructions for use
statements.object_as_written: a copy of the instructions for use
statements.object_normalised: a copy of the instructions for use
statements.quote: (i) a copy of the instructions for use and the information set out in section 1.7.4 of Annex III;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall specify the means used by the manufacturer to ensure the conformity
statements.object_as_written: shall specify the means used by the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: shall specify the means used by the manufacturer to ensure the conformity
statements.quote: PART B Technical documentation for partly completed machinery The technical documentation shall specify the means used by the manufacturer to ensure the conformity of the partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: the documentation shall specify the parts, which have been applied
statements.object_as_written: the documentation shall specify the parts, which have been applied
statements.object_normalised: the documentation shall specify the parts, which have been applied
statements.condition: In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications
statements.quote: In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the documentation shall specify the parts, which have been applied;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: descriptions of the other technical specifications that have been applied
statements.object_as_written: descriptions of the other technical specifications that have been applied
statements.object_normalised: descriptions of the other technical specifications that have been applied
statements.condition: where harmonised standards or common specifications have not been applied or have been only partially applied
statements.quote: (f) where harmonised standards or common specifications have not been applied or have been only partially applied, descriptions of the other technical specifications that have been applied in order to meet each applicable essential health and safety requirement;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: the source code or programming logic of the safety related software
statements.object_as_written: the source code or programming logic of the safety related software
statements.object_normalised: the source code or programming logic of the safety related software
statements.condition: upon a reasoned request from a competent national authority, provided that is necessary in order for those authorities to be able to check compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III
statements.quote: (k) the source code or programming logic of the safety related software upon a reasoned request from a competent national authority, provided that is necessary in order for those authorities to be able to check compliance with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production of the partly completed machinery
statements.object_as_written: a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production
statements.object_normalised: a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production of the partly completed machinery
statements.quote: (h) a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production of the partly completed machinery to ensure the conformity of the partly completed machinery produced with the design specifications;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity
statements.object_as_written: the internal measures that will be implemented
statements.object_normalised: the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity
statements.condition: for partly completed machinery produced in series
statements.quote: (j) for partly completed machinery produced in series, the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements applied;

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A
statements.object: Declaration must contain listed particulars; no relation fits
statements.quote: PART A EU declaration of conformity of machinery and related products No … ( 1 ) The EU declaration of conformity shall contain the following particulars:

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A, point 2
statements.object: Declaration content item: manufacturer name and address, authorised representative
statements.quote: Name and address of the manufacturer and, where applicable, its authorised representative.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A, point 3
statements.object: address of assembly place for permanently installed lifting machinery
statements.quote: For lifting machinery which is intended to be permanently installed in a building or a structure and which cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises but can only be assembled at the place of use, the address of that place.

statements.subject: manufacturer, declaration of conformity
statements.object: issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.quote: This declaration of conformity is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A, point 5
statements.object: Declaration object: identification for traceability; colour image optional
statements.quote: Object of the declaration (identification of the machinery or related product allowing traceability; where necessary for the identification of the machinery or related product, a colour image of sufficient clarity may be included).

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A, point 7
statements.object: EU declaration must list harmonised standards or specifications applied, with dates
statements.quote: References to the harmonised standards referred to in Article 20(1) or common specifications adopted by the Commission in accordance with Article 20(3) that were applied, including the date of the publication of the reference to harmonised standards in the Official Journal of the European Union or of the common specification, or references to the other technical specifications, including their date, in relation to which conformity is declared. In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the EU declaration of conformity shall specify the parts which were applied.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part A, point 8
statements.object: Conformity modules listed for a template entry, no machinery category named
statements.quote: Where applicable, the notified body … (name, number) … performed the EU type-examination (Module B) and issued the EU type-examination certificate … (reference to that certificate), followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) or the conformity based on unit verification (module G) or full quality assurance (module H).

statements.subject: machinery or related product
statements.object: internal production control (module a)
statements.object_as_written: internal production control (Module A)
statements.object_normalised: internal production control (module a)
statements.condition: Where applicable
statements.quote: Where applicable, the machinery or related product is subject to the conformity assessment procedure based on internal production control (Module A).

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 1
statements.object: Identification of partly completed machinery required in declaration
statements.quote: The partly completed machinery (product, type, model batch or serial number).

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer
statements.quote: This declaration of incorporation is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 4
statements.object: Declaration object content for partly completed machinery; colour image optional
statements.quote: Object of the declaration (identification of partly completed machinery allowing traceability; where necessary for the identification of the partly completed machinery, a colour image of sufficient clarity may be included).

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 5
statements.object: Declaration of conformity content for partly completed machinery
statements.quote: A sentence declaring which essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( 3 ) are applied and fulfilled and that the relevant technical documentation was drawn-up in accordance with Annex IV, Part B, and, where appropriate, a sentence declaring the conformity of the partly completed machinery with other relevant Union harmonisation legislation.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 6
statements.object: EU declaration must list applied standards with dates and partial parts
statements.quote: References to the harmonised standards referred to in Article 20(1) or common specifications adopted by the Commission in accordance with Article 20(3) that were applied, including the date of the standard or of the common specification, or references to the other technical specifications, including their date, in relation to which conformity is declared. In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the EU declaration of incorporation shall specify the parts which were applied.

statements.subject: undertaking
statements.object: undertaking to transmit relevant information
statements.object_as_written: undertaking to transmit
statements.object_normalised: undertaking to transmit relevant information
statements.condition: in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities
statements.quote: An undertaking to transmit, in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities, relevant information on the partly completed machinery.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 7
statements.object: transmission must not prejudice manufacturer's intellectual property rights
statements.quote: This shall include the method of transmission and shall be without prejudice to the intellectual property rights of the manufacturer of the partly completed machinery.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 8
statements.object: Statement: no service until final machinery declared conforming
statements.quote: A statement that the partly completed machinery shall not be put into service until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with this Regulation.

statements.subject: Annex V, Part B, point 9
statements.object: Repeal of Directive 2006/42/EC stated; no effective date given
statements.quote: ( 3 ) Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Directive 73/361/EEC ( OJ L 165, 29.6.2023, p.

statements.subject: internal production control
statements.object: the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations
statements.object_as_written: the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations
statements.object_normalised: the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations
statements.quote: Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4
statements.object_as_written: fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4
statements.object_normalised: fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4
statements.quote: Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Annex VI
statements.object: machinery category to which Module A applies not stated
statements.quote: ANNEX VI INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module A) 1.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall draw up the technical documentation
statements.object_as_written: shall draw up the technical documentation
statements.object_normalised: shall draw up the technical documentation
statements.quote: Technical documentation The manufacturer shall draw up the technical documentation described in Annex IV, Part A.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: shall take all measures necessary
statements.object_as_written: shall take all measures necessary
statements.object_normalised: shall take all measures necessary
statements.quote: Manufacturing The manufacturer shall take all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure compliance of the manufactured machinery or related products with the technical documentation referred to in point 2 and with the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Annex VI, 4
statements.object: Obligated party for providing the EU declaration copy is not named
statements.quote: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be made available to the relevant authorities upon request.

statements.subject: manufacturer's obligations set out in point 4
statements.object: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.object_as_written: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.object_normalised: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.condition: provided that they are specified in the mandate
statements.quote: Authorised representative The manufacturer’s obligations set out in point 4 may be fulfilled by its authorised representative, on its behalf and under its responsibility, provided that they are specified in the mandate.

statements.subject: EU type-examination
statements.object: the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body examines the technical design
statements.object_as_written: the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body examines the technical design
statements.object_normalised: the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body examines the technical design
statements.quote: EU type-examination is the part of a conformity assessment procedure in which a notified body examines the technical design of machinery or a related product and verifies and attests that the technical design of the machinery or related product meets the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Annex VII
statements.object: type-examination method (documentation plus specimen) fits no relation
statements.quote: EU type-examination shall be carried out by assessment of the adequacy of the technical design of the machinery or related product through examination of the technical documentation, plus examination of a specimen of the machinery or related product that is representative of the production envisaged (production type).

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: lodge an application for eu type-examination with a single notified body
statements.object_as_written: shall lodge an application
statements.object_normalised: lodge an application for eu type-examination with a single notified body
statements.quote: Application for EU type-examination The manufacturer shall lodge an application for EU type-examination with a single notified body of its choice.

statements.subject: Annex VII, 3
statements.object: specimen rules for series and single-unit machinery differ
statements.quote: The notified body may request further specimens if needed for carrying out the test programme. For machinery or related products produced in series where each item is adapted to fit an individual user, specimens shall be provided that are representative of the range of different users, while for machinery or related products produced as a single unit to accommodate the special needs of an individual user, a basic model shall be provided.

statements.subject: Annex VII, 5
statements.object: notified body must draw up report; release only with manufacturer agreement
statements.quote: Evaluation report The notified body shall draw up an evaluation report that records the activities undertaken in accordance with point 4 and their outcomes. Without prejudice to its obligations vis-à-vis the notifying authorities, the notified body shall release the content of that report, in full or in part, only with the agreement of the manufacturer.

statements.subject: Annex VII, 6
statements.object: Certificate validity may not exceed five years
statements.quote: The period of validity of a newly issued certificate and, where appropriate, of a renewed certificate shall not exceed five years.

statements.subject: copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical file kept by notified body
statements.object: P5Y
statements.object_as_written: for a period of five years
statements.object_normalised: P5Y
statements.quote: The notified body shall keep a copy of the EU type-examination certificate, its annexes and additions, as well as the technical file including the documentation submitted by the manufacturer, for a period of five years after the expiry of the validity of that certificate.

statements.subject: copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer
statements.object: P10Y
statements.object_as_written: for at least 10 years
statements.object_normalised: P10Y
statements.condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service
statements.quote: The manufacturer shall keep a copy of the EU type-examination certificate, its annexes and additions, together with the technical documentation at the disposal of the national authorities, for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service.

statements.subject: manufacturer's authorised representative
statements.object: fulfil the obligations set out in points 7.2, 7.4 and 9
statements.object_as_written: fulfil the obligations set out in points 7.2, 7.4 and 9
statements.object_normalised: fulfil the obligations set out in points 7.2, 7.4 and 9
statements.condition: provided that they are specified in the mandate
statements.quote: The manufacturer’s authorised representative may lodge the application referred to in point 3 and fulfil the obligations set out in points 7.2, 7.4 and 9, provided that they are specified in the mandate.

statements.subject: Annex VII, 7
statements.object: renewal application window of 12 to 6 months before expiry
statements.quote: In the case referred to in point (c), the review may lead to a renewal of the EU type-examination certificate only when the application is submitted by the manufacturer at the earliest 12 months and at the latest 6 months prior to the expiry date of the EU type-examination certificate.

statements.subject: conformity to type based on internal production control
statements.object: the part of a conformity assessment procedure
statements.object_as_written: the part of a conformity assessment procedure
statements.object_normalised: the part of a conformity assessment procedure
statements.quote: Conformity to type based on internal production control is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2 and 3, and ensures and declares under its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: ensures and declares under its sole responsibility
statements.object_as_written: ensures and declares under its sole responsibility
statements.object_normalised: ensures and declares under its sole responsibility
statements.quote: Conformity to type based on internal production control is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2 and 3, and ensures and declares under its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: the manufacturer shall take all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure conformity
statements.object_as_written: The manufacturer shall take all measures necessary
statements.object_normalised: the manufacturer shall take all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure conformity
statements.quote: Manufacturing The manufacturer shall take all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure conformity of the manufactured machinery or related products with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and with the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

statements.subject: Annex VIII, 3
statements.object: Obligation holder not named; copy supplied upon request
statements.quote: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be made available to the relevant authorities upon request.

statements.subject: manufacturer's obligations set out in point 3
statements.object: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.object_as_written: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.object_normalised: may be fulfilled by its authorised representative
statements.condition: provided that they are specified in the mandate
statements.quote: Authorised representative The manufacturer’s obligations set out in point 3 may be fulfilled by its authorised representative, on its behalf and under its responsibility, provided that they are specified in the mandate.

statements.subject: Art. 1(1)
statements.object: Directive applies to listed product types (scope)
statements.quote: This Directive applies to the following products: (a) machinery;

statements.subject: Art. 1(2)
statements.object: Scope exclusions for spare parts, fairgrounds, nuclear, weapons, transport, vessels
statements.quote: The following are excluded from the scope of this Directive: (a) safety components intended to be used as spare parts to replace identical components and supplied by the manufacturer of the original machinery; (b) specific equipment for use in fairgrounds and/or amusement parks;

statements.subject: safety component
statements.object: means a component
statements.object_as_written: means a component
statements.object_normalised: means a component
statements.condition: which is independently placed on the market
statements.quote: (c) ‘safety component’ means a component: — which serves to fulfil a safety function, — which is independently placed on the market, — the failure and/or malfunction of which endangers the safety of persons, and — which is not necessary in order for the machinery to function, or for which normal components may be substituted in order for the machinery to function.

statements.subject: safety components
statements.object: annex v
statements.object_as_written: Annex V
statements.object_normalised: annex v
statements.quote: An indicative list of safety components is set out in Annex V, which may be updated in accordance with Article 8(1)(a);

statements.subject: any natural or legal person who places on the market or puts into service machinery
statements.object: shall be considered a manufacturer
statements.object_as_written: shall be considered a manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: shall be considered a manufacturer
statements.condition: In the absence of a manufacturer as defined above
statements.quote: In the absence of a manufacturer as defined above, any natural or legal person who places on the market or puts into service machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive shall be considered a manufacturer;

statements.subject: placing on the market
statements.object: means making available for the first time in the community
statements.object_as_written: means making available for the first time in the Community
statements.object_normalised: means making available for the first time in the community
statements.quote: (h) ‘placing on the market’ means making available for the first time in the Community machinery or partly completed machinery with a view to distribution or use, whether for reward or free of charge;

statements.subject: manufacturer
statements.object: means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery
statements.object_as_written: means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery
statements.object_normalised: means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery
statements.condition: under his own name or trademark or for his own use
statements.quote: (i) ‘manufacturer’ means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive and is responsible for the conformity of the machinery or the partly completed machinery with this Directive with a view to its being placed on the market, under his own name or trademark or for his own use.

statements.subject: putting into service
statements.object: means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the community
statements.object_as_written: means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community
statements.object_normalised: means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the community
statements.quote: (k) ‘putting into service’ means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by this Directive;

statements.subject: authorised representative
statements.object: means any natural or legal person established in the community
statements.object_as_written: means any natural or legal person established in the Community
statements.object_normalised: means any natural or legal person established in the community
statements.condition: who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer
statements.quote: (j) ‘authorised representative’ means any natural or legal person established in the Community who has received a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform on his behalf all or part of the obligations and formalities connected with this Directive;

statements.subject: harmonised standard
statements.object: means a non-binding technical specification
statements.object_as_written: means a non-binding technical specification
statements.object_normalised: means a non-binding technical specification
statements.quote: (l) ‘harmonised standard’ means a non-binding technical specification adopted by a standardisation body, namely the European Committee for Standardisation (CEN), the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardisation (CENELEC) or the European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI), on the basis of a remit issued by the Commission in accordance with the procedures laid down in Directive 98/34/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 June 1998 laying down a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations and of rules on Information Society services ( 16 ) .

statements.subject: lifting accessory
statements.object: means a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.object_as_written: means a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.object_normalised: means a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery
statements.condition: which is independently placed on the market
statements.quote: (d) ‘lifting accessory’ means a component or equipment not attached to the lifting machinery, allowing the load to be held, which is placed between the machinery and the load or on the load itself, or which is intended to constitute an integral part of the load and which is independently placed on the market;

statements.subject: Art. 2
statements.object: guarded transmission device treated as one product when placed on market
statements.quote: When it is placed on the market with the guard it shall be regarded as one product;

statements.subject: Art. 3
statements.object: scope exclusion for hazards covered by other directives
statements.quote: Article 3 Specific Directives Where, for machinery, the hazards referred to in Annex I are wholly or partly covered more specifically by other Community Directives, this Directive shall not apply, or shall cease to apply, to that machinery in respect of such hazards from the date of implementation of those other Directives.

statements.subject: Art. 4(1)
statements.object: Member States must ensure only compliant machinery reaches market
statements.quote: Member States shall take all appropriate measures to ensure that machinery may be placed on the market and/or put into service only if it satisfies the relevant provisions of this Directive and does not endanger the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or property, when properly installed and maintained and used for its intended purpose or under conditions which can reasonably be foreseen.

statements.subject: Art. 4(2)
statements.object: Member States ensure partly completed machinery is placed on market only if compliant
statements.quote: Member States shall take all appropriate measures to ensure that partly completed machinery can be placed on the market only if it satisfies the relevant provisions of this Directive.

statements.subject: Art. 4(3)
statements.object: Member States must appoint authorities monitoring machinery conformity
statements.quote: Member States shall institute or appoint the competent authorities to monitor the conformity of machinery and partly completed machinery with the provisions set out in paragraphs 1 and 2.

statements.subject: Art. 4(4)
statements.object: Member States define competent authorities' tasks, powers; notify Commission
statements.quote: Member States shall define the tasks, organisation and powers of the competent authorities referred to in paragraph 3 and shall notify the Commission and other Member States thereof and also of any subsequent amendment.

statements.subject: manufacturer or authorised representative
statements.object: ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements
statements.object_as_written: ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements
statements.object_normalised: ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements
statements.condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service
statements.quote: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall: (a) ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I;

statements.subject: manufacturer or authorised representative
statements.object: ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available
statements.object_as_written: ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available
statements.object_normalised: ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available
statements.condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service
statements.quote: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall: (a) ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I; (b) ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available;

statements.subject: machinery
statements.object: ec declaration of conformity
statements.object_as_written: EC declaration of conformity
statements.object_normalised: ec declaration of conformity
statements.quote: (e) draw up the EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A and ensure that it accompanies the machinery;

statements.subject: manufacturer or his authorised representative
statements.object: shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed
statements.object_as_written: shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed
statements.object_normalised: shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed
statements.condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market
statements.quote: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed.

statements.subject: manufacturer or his authorised representative
statements.object: shall have, or shall have access to, the necessary means
statements.object_as_written: shall have, or shall have access to, the necessary means
statements.object_normalised: shall have, or shall have access to, the necessary means
statements.condition: For the purposes of the procedures referred to in Article 12
statements.quote: For the purposes of the procedures referred to in Article 12, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall have, or shall have access to, the necessary means of ensuring that the machinery satisfies the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I.

statements.subject: Art. 5(4)
statements.object: CE marking scope and EC declaration particulars; no fitting relation
statements.quote: Where machinery is also the subject of other Directives relating to other aspects and providing for the affixing of the CE marking, the marking shall indicate that the machinery also conforms to the provisions of those other Directives. However, where one or more of those Directives allow the manufacturer or his authorised representative to choose, during a transitional period, the system to be applied, the CE marking shall indicate conformity only to the provisions of those Directives applied by the manufacturer or his authorised representative. Particulars of the Directives applied, as published in the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be given on the EC declaration of conformity.

statements.subject: Art. 6(1)
statements.object: Member States must not prohibit, restrict or impede compliant machinery
statements.quote: Member States shall not prohibit, restrict or impede the placing on the market and/or putting into service in their territory of machinery which complies with this Directive.

statements.subject: manufacturer or his authorised representative
statements.object: makes a declaration of incorporation
statements.object_as_written: makes a declaration of incorporation
statements.object_normalised: makes a declaration of incorporation
statements.condition: stating that it is to be incorporated into machinery or assembled with other partly completed machinery to form machinery
statements.quote: Member States shall not prohibit, restrict or impede the placing on the market of partly completed machinery where the manufacturer or his authorised representative makes a declaration of incorporation, referred to in Annex II, part 1, Section B, stating that it is to be incorporated into machinery or assembled with other partly completed machinery to form machinery.

statements.subject: Art. 6(2)
statements.object: No prohibition on placing partly completed machinery on market

statements.quote: At trade fairs, exhibitions, demonstrations, and such like, Member States shall not prevent the showing of machinery or partly completed machinery which does not conform to this Directive, provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that it does not conform and that it will not be made available until it has been brought into conformity. Furthermore, during demonstrations of such non-conforming machinery or partly completed machinery, adequate safety measures shall be taken to ensure the protection of persons.

statements.quote: The Commission shall publish in the Official Journal of the European Union the references of the harmonised standards.

When, in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 11, the Commission considers that a measure taken by a Member State is justified, the Commission may, in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article, take measures requiring Member States to prohibit or restrict the placing on the market of machinery presenting the same risk by virtue of its technical characteristics or to make such machinery subject to special conditions.

statements.subject: Art. 9(2)

statements.subject: Art. 9(3)
