statements.quote: In the cases referred to in paragraph 1, the Commission shall consult the Member States and other interested parties indicating the measures it intends to take, in order to ensure, at Community level, a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons. Taking due account of the results of this consultation, it shall adopt the necessary measures in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 22(3).

statements.subject: Art. 10
statements.object: Committee opinion procedure for disputing harmonised standard has no relation
statements.quote: The committee shall deliver an opinion without delay. In the light of the committee's opinion, the Commission shall decide to publish, not to publish, to publish with restriction, to maintain, to maintain with restriction or to withdraw the references to the harmonised standard concerned in the Official Journal of the European Union.

statements.subject: Art. 11(1)
statements.object: Member State safeguard duty; no matching relation
statements.quote: Where a Member State ascertains that machinery covered by this Directive, bearing the CE marking, accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity and used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions which can reasonably be foreseen, is liable to compromise the health and safety of persons and, where appropriate, domestic animals or property, it shall take all appropriate measures to withdraw such machinery from the market, to prohibit the placing on the market and/or putting into service of such machinery or to restrict free movement thereof.

statements.subject: Art. 11(2)
statements.object: Member State must immediately notify Commission and other states of safeguard measure
statements.quote: The Member State shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States of any such measure, indicating the reasons for its decision and, in particular, whether the non-conformity is due to:

statements.subject: Art. 11(3)

statements.quote: The Commission shall enter into consultation with the parties concerned without delay. The Commission shall consider, after this consultation, whether or not the measures taken by the Member State are justified, and it shall communicate its decision to the Member State which took the initiative, the other Member States, and the manufacturer or his authorised representative.

statements.subject: Art. 11(4)
statements.object: Commission or Member State must initiate Article 10 procedure if harmonised standards shortcoming persists
statements.quote: Where the measures referred to in paragraph 1 are based on a shortcoming in the harmonised standards and if the Member State which instigated the measures maintains its position, the Commission or the Member State shall initiate the procedure referred to in Article 10.

statements.subject: Art. 11(5)
statements.object: Member State must act on non-conforming CE-marked machinery and notify Commission
statements.quote: Where machinery does not conform and bears the CE marking, the competent Member State shall take appropriate action against whomsoever has affixed the marking and shall so inform the Commission. The Commission shall inform the other Member States.

statements.subject: Art. 11(6)
statements.object: Commission must keep Member States informed of procedure
statements.quote: The Commission shall ensure that Member States are kept informed of the progress and outcome of the procedure.

statements.subject: Art. 14(1)

Member States shall notify the Commission and other Member States of any subsequent amendment.

statements.object_normalised: Member States
statements.quote: The Member States shall ensure that the notified bodies are monitored regularly to check that they comply at all times with the criteria set out in Annex XI.

statements.subject: Art. 14(2)
statements.object: notified body must provide information on request; no matching relation
statements.quote: The notified body shall provide all relevant information on request, including budgetary documents, to enable the Member States to ensure that the requirements of Annex XI are met.

statements.subject: Art. 14(3)
statements.object: Member States must apply Annex XI criteria to notified bodies; no relation fits
statements.quote: Member States shall apply the criteria set out in Annex XI in assessing the bodies to be notified and the bodies already notified.

statements.subject: Art. 14(4)
statements.object: Commission publishes and keeps up to date list of notified bodies
statements.quote: The Commission shall publish in the Official Journal of the European Union, for information, a list of the notified bodies and their identification numbers and the tasks for which they have been notified. The Commission shall ensure that this list is kept up to date.

statements.subject: Art. 14(5)
statements.object: presumption of conformity for notified bodies meeting harmonised standards
statements.quote: Bodies meeting the assessment criteria laid down in the relevant harmonised standards, the references of which shall be published in the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be presumed to fulfil the relevant criteria.

statements.subject: Art. 14(6)
statements.object: Notified body duty to suspend or withdraw certificates
statements.quote: If a notified body finds that relevant requirements of this Directive have not been met or are no longer met by the manufacturer or that an EC type-examination certificate or the approval of a quality assurance system should not have been issued, it shall, taking account of the principle of proportionality, suspend or withdraw the certificate or the approval issued or place restrictions on it, giving detailed reasons, unless compliance with such requirements is ensured by the implementation of appropriate corrective measures by the manufacturer. In the event of suspension or withdrawal of the certificate or the approval or of any restriction placed on it, or in cases where intervention by the competent authority may prove necessary, the notified body shall inform the competent authority pursuant to Article 4.

statements.subject: Art. 14(7)
statements.object: Commission must organise exchange of experience on notified bodies
statements.quote: The Commission shall provide for the organisation of an exchange of experience between the authorities responsible for appointment, notification and monitoring of notified bodies in the Member States, and the notified bodies, in order to coordinate the uniform application of this Directive.

statements.subject: Art. 14(8)
statements.object: Member State must withdraw notification, no relation covers it
statements.quote: A Member State which has notified a body shall immediately withdraw its notification if it finds: (a) that the body no longer meets the criteria set out in Annex XI; or (b) that the body seriously fails to fulfil its responsibilities.

statements.subject: Art. 15
statements.object: Member States may set use requirements; machinery must not be modified
statements.quote: Article 15 Installation and use of machinery This Directive shall not affect Member States' entitlement to lay down, in due observance of Community law, such requirements as they may deem necessary to ensure that persons, and in particular workers, are protected when using machinery, provided that this does not mean that such machinery is modified in a way not specified in this Directive.

statements.quote: The affixing on machinery of markings, signs and inscriptions which are likely to mislead third parties as to the meaning or form of the CE marking, or both, shall be prohibited. Any other marking may be affixed to the machinery provided that the visibility, legibility and meaning of the CE marking is not thereby impaired.

statements.object: Member State must restrict, prohibit or withdraw non-conforming products; not an economic operator
statements.quote: Where non-conformity persists, the Member State shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the placing on the market of the product in question or to ensure that it is withdrawn from the market in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 11.

statements.subject: Art. 18(1)
statements.object: Confidentiality duty on all parties; business secrets exception
statements.quote: Without prejudice to existing national provisions and practices in the area of confidentiality, Members States shall ensure that all parties and persons concerned by the application of this Directive are required to treat as confidential information obtained in the execution of their tasks. More particularly business, professional and trade secrets shall be treated as confidential, unless the divulging of such information is necessary in order to protect the health and safety of persons.

statements.subject: Art. 18(2)
statements.object: Confidentiality does not limit Member States' and notified bodies' information exchange, warnings
statements.quote: 2. The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not affect the obligations of the Member States and the notified bodies with regard to mutual exchange of information and the issuing of warnings.

statements.subject: Art. 18(3)
statements.object: Decisions under Articles 9 and 11 must be published; no matching relation
statements.quote: Any decisions taken by the Member States and by the Commission in accordance with Articles 9 and 11 shall be published.

statements.subject: Art. 19(1)
statements.object: Member States must cooperate with each other and the Commission
statements.quote: Member States shall take the appropriate measures to ensure that the competent authorities referred to in Article 4(3) cooperate with each other and with the Commission and transmit to each other the information necessary to enable this Directive to be applied uniformly.

statements.subject: Art. 19(2)
statements.object: Commission to organise exchange of experience between market surveillance authorities
statements.quote: The Commission shall provide for the organisation of an exchange of experience between the competent authorities responsible for market surveillance in order to coordinate the uniform application of this Directive.

statements.subject: Art. 20
statements.object: Restricting measures must state grounds and notify remedies and time limits
statements.quote: Article 20 Legal remedies Any measure taken pursuant to this Directive which restricts the placing on the market and/or putting into service of any machinery covered by this Directive shall state the exact grounds on which it is based. Such a measure shall be notified as soon as possible to the party concerned, who shall at the same time be informed of the legal remedies available to him under the laws in force in the Member State concerned and of the time limits to which such remedies are subject.

statements.object: Commission must disseminate information on implementing the Directive; no relation fits
statements.quote: Article 21 Dissemination of information The Commission shall take the necessary measures for appropriate information concerning the implementation of this Directive to be made available.

statements.quote: Equivalent steps must be taken if this requirement is not technically feasible, — permit, where necessary, visual observation of the danger zone and of the action of the tool with the material being processed.

statements.subject: Annex I, 2.2.1
statements.object: handle design for straightforward starting and stopping has no matching relation
statements.quote: The handles of portable machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to make starting and stopping straightforward.

statements.subject: vibration total value to which the hand-arm system is subjected
statements.object: if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2
statements.object_as_written: if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2
statements.object_normalised: if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2
statements.condition: if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2
statements.quote: Instructions The instructions must give the following information concerning vibrations transmitted by portable hand-held and hand-guided machinery: — the vibration total value to which the hand-arm system is subjected, if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2 .

statements.subject: vibration total value not exceeding 2,5 m/s 2
statements.object: this must be mentioned
statements.object_as_written: Where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2 , this must be mentioned
statements.object_normalised: this must be mentioned
statements.condition: where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2
statements.quote: Where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2 , this must be mentioned, — the uncertainty of measurement.

statements.subject: uncertainty of measurement
statements.object: the uncertainty of measurement
statements.object_as_written: the uncertainty of measurement
statements.object_normalised: the uncertainty of measurement
statements.quote: Where this value does not exceed 2,5 m/s 2 , this must be mentioned, — the uncertainty of measurement.

statements.subject: vibration values
statements.object: must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question
statements.object_as_written: must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question
statements.object_normalised: must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question
statements.condition: or those established on the basis of measurements taken for technically comparable machinery
statements.quote: These values must be either those actually measured for the machinery in question or those established on the basis of measurements taken for technically comparable machinery which is representative of the machinery to be produced.

statements.subject: vibration data
statements.object: must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery
statements.object_as_written: must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery
statements.object_normalised: must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery
statements.condition: If harmonised standards are not applied
statements.quote: If harmonised standards are not applied, the vibration data must be measured using the most appropriate measurement code for the machinery.

statements.subject: operating conditions during measurement and measurement methods
statements.object: must be specified
statements.object_as_written: must be specified
statements.object_normalised: must be specified
statements.condition: or the reference of the harmonised standard applied
statements.quote: The operating conditions during measurement and the methods used for measurement, or the reference of the harmonised standard applied, must be specified.

statements.subject: portable fixing and other impact machinery
statements.object: enabling device
statements.object_as_written: enabling device
statements.object_normalised: enabling device
statements.condition: unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material
statements.quote: General Portable fixing and other impact machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that: — energy is transmitted to the impacted element by the intermediary component that does not leave the device, — an enabling device prevents impact unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material, — involuntary triggering is prevented;

statements.subject: trigger of an impact
statements.object: an appropriate sequence of actions
statements.object_as_written: an appropriate sequence of actions
statements.object_normalised: an appropriate sequence of actions
statements.condition: where necessary
statements.quote: where necessary, an appropriate sequence of actions on the enabling device and the control device must be required to trigger an impact, — accidental triggering is prevented during handling or in case of shock, — loading and unloading operations can be carried out easily and safely.

statements.subject: essential requirement 2.2.2.1
statements.object: accidental triggering
statements.object_as_written: accidental triggering
statements.object_normalised: accidental triggering
statements.quote: where necessary, an appropriate sequence of actions on the enabling device and the control device must be required to trigger an impact, — accidental triggering is prevented during handling or in case of shock, — loading and unloading operations can be carried out easily and safely.

statements.subject: impact machinery device
statements.object: splinter guard(s)
statements.object_as_written: splinter guard(s)
statements.object_normalised: splinter guard(s)
statements.condition: where necessary
statements.quote: Where necessary, it must be possible to fit the device with splinter guard(s) and the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer of the machinery.

statements.subject: manufacturer of the machinery
statements.object: provide the appropriate guard(s)
statements.object_as_written: the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer
statements.object_normalised: provide the appropriate guard(s)
statements.condition: where necessary
statements.quote: Where necessary, it must be possible to fit the device with splinter guard(s) and the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer of the machinery.

statements.subject: Annex I, 2.2.2.2
statements.object: Content required for instructions: accessories, fixing elements, cartridges
statements.quote: Instructions The instructions must give the necessary information regarding: — the accessories and interchangeable equipment that can be used with the machinery, — the suitable fixing or other impacted elements to be used with the machinery, — where appropriate, the suitable cartridges to be used.

statements.subject: 2.3(b) ejection of workpieces
statements.object: risk of ejection of workpieces
statements.object_as_written: risk of ejection of workpieces
statements.object_normalised: risk of ejection of workpieces
statements.condition: where the machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving the risk of ejection of workpieces or parts of them
statements.quote: (b) where the machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving the risk of ejection of workpieces or parts of them, it must be designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection, or, if this is not possible, so that the ejection does not engender risks for the operator and/or exposed persons;

statements.subject: 2.3(b) machinery
statements.object: designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection
statements.object_as_written: designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection
statements.object_normalised: designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection
statements.condition: if this is not possible, so that the ejection does not engender risks for the operator and/or exposed persons
statements.quote: (b) where the machinery is likely to be used in conditions involving the risk of ejection of workpieces or parts of them, it must be designed, constructed, or equipped in such a way as to prevent such ejection, or, if this is not possible, so that the ejection does not engender risks for the operator and/or exposed persons;

statements.subject: 2.3(c) machinery
statements.object: automatic brake
statements.object_as_written: automatic brake
statements.object_normalised: automatic brake
statements.condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down
statements.quote: (c) the machinery must be equipped with an automatic brake that stops the tool in a sufficiently short time if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down;

statements.subject: 2.3(c) tool running down
statements.object: risk of contact with the tool
statements.object_as_written: risk of contact with the tool
statements.object_normalised: risk of contact with the tool
statements.condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down
statements.quote: (c) the machinery must be equipped with an automatic brake that stops the tool in a sufficiently short time if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down;

statements.subject: 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine
statements.object: risk of accidental injury
statements.object_as_written: risk of accidental injury
statements.object_normalised: risk of accidental injury
statements.condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine
statements.quote: (d) where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine, the latter must be designed and constructed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce the risk of accidental injury.

statements.subject: 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine
statements.object: designed and constructed in such a way
statements.object_as_written: designed and constructed in such a way
statements.object_normalised: designed and constructed in such a way
statements.condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine
statements.quote: (d) where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine, the latter must be designed and constructed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce the risk of accidental injury.

statements.subject: Annex I, 2.3
statements.object: 2.3(a) placing and guiding the piece: no risk named
statements.quote: (a) the machinery must be designed, constructed or equipped in such a way that the piece being machined can be placed and guided in safety;

statements.subject: Annex I, 3
statements.object: Mobile machinery must meet all essential requirements of this chapter
statements.quote: SUPPLEMENTARY ESSENTIAL HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS TO OFFSET HAZARDS DUE TO THE MOBILITY OF MACHINERY Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility must meet all the essential health and safety requirements described in this chapter (see General Principles, point 4).

statements.subject: Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility
statements.object: machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility
statements.object_as_written: Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility
statements.object_normalised: machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility
statements.quote: Definitions (a) ‘Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility’ means — machinery the operation of which requires either mobility while working, or continuous or semi-continuous movement between a succession of fixed working locations, or — machinery which is operated without being moved, but which may be equipped in such a way as to enable it to be moved more easily from one place to another.

statements.subject: Driver
statements.object: an operator responsible for the movement of a machine
statements.object_as_written: an operator responsible for the movement of a machine
statements.object_normalised: an operator responsible for the movement of a machine
statements.quote: (b) ‘Driver’ means an operator responsible for the movement of a machine.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.1.1
statements.object: Driver may be carried, on foot or remote-controlled
statements.quote: The driver may be transported by the machinery or may be on foot, accompanying the machinery, or may guide the machinery by remote control.

statements.subject: driving position visibility
statements.object: appropriate devices
statements.object_as_written: appropriate devices
statements.object_normalised: appropriate devices
statements.condition: Where necessary
statements.quote: Where necessary, appropriate devices must be provided to remedy hazards due to inadequate direct vision.

statements.subject: driving position visibility
statements.object: inadvertent contact with the wheels and tracks
statements.object_as_written: inadvertent contact with the wheels and tracks
statements.object_normalised: inadvertent contact with the wheels and tracks
statements.condition: from the driving positions
statements.quote: Machinery on which the driver is transported must be designed and constructed in such a way that, from the driving positions, there is no risk to the driver from inadvertent contact with the wheels and tracks.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.2.1
statements.object: cab fitting allowed if no added risk; instructions place required
statements.quote: The driving position of ride-on drivers must be designed and constructed in such a way that a driver's cab may be fitted, provided this does not increase the risk and there is room for it. The cab must incorporate a place for the instructions needed for the driver.

statements.subject: 3.2.2 seating
statements.object: crushed between parts of the machinery and the ground
statements.object_as_written: crushed between parts of the machinery and the ground
statements.object_normalised: crushed between parts of the machinery and the ground
statements.condition: should the machinery roll or tip over
statements.quote: Seating Where there is a risk that operators or other persons transported by the machinery may be crushed between parts of the machinery and the ground should the machinery roll or tip over, in particular for machinery equipped with a protective structure referred to in section 3.4.3 or 3.4.4, their seats must be designed or equipped with a restraint system so as to keep the persons in their seats, without restricting movements necessary for operations or movements relative to the structure caused by the suspension of the seats.

statements.subject: seats
statements.object: restraint system
statements.object_as_written: restraint system
statements.object_normalised: restraint system
statements.condition: without restricting movements necessary for operations or movements relative to the structure caused by the suspension of the seats
statements.quote: Seating Where there is a risk that operators or other persons transported by the machinery may be crushed between parts of the machinery and the ground should the machinery roll or tip over, in particular for machinery equipped with a protective structure referred to in section 3.4.3 or 3.4.4, their seats must be designed or equipped with a restraint system so as to keep the persons in their seats, without restricting movements necessary for operations or movements relative to the structure caused by the suspension of the seats.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.2.2
statements.object: restraint not fitted if it increases risk
statements.quote: Such restraint systems should not be fitted if they increase the risk.

statements.subject: positions for other persons
statements.object: appropriate positions
statements.object_as_written: appropriate positions must be provided
statements.object_normalised: appropriate positions
statements.condition: If the conditions of use provide that persons other than the driver may occasionally or regularly be transported by the machinery or work on it
statements.quote: Positions for other persons If the conditions of use provide that persons other than the driver may occasionally or regularly be transported by the machinery or work on it, appropriate positions must be provided which enable them to be transported or to work on it without risk.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.2.3
statements.object: paragraphs 2 and 3 of section 3.2.1 also apply to driver-excluded places
statements.quote: The second and third paragraphs of section 3.2.1 also apply to the places provided for persons other than the driver.

statements.subject: control systems
statements.object: steps must be taken to prevent unauthorised use of controls
statements.object_as_written: steps must be taken to prevent unauthorised use of controls
statements.object_normalised: steps must be taken to prevent unauthorised use of controls
statements.condition: If necessary
statements.quote: CONTROL SYSTEMS If necessary, steps must be taken to prevent unauthorised use of controls.

statements.subject: remote controlled machinery
statements.object: designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units
statements.object_as_written: designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units
statements.object_normalised: designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units
statements.quote: Remote controlled machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3
statements.object: remote system must affect only the machinery and functions in question
statements.quote: The remote control system must be designed and constructed in such a way as to affect only: — the machinery in question, — the functions in question.

statements.subject: control devices
statements.object: return to the neutral position
statements.object_as_written: return to the neutral position
statements.object_normalised: return to the neutral position
statements.condition: where their operation can lead to hazards, notably dangerous movements; except for those with preset positions
statements.quote: Where their operation can lead to hazards, notably dangerous movements, the control devices, except for those with preset positions, must return to the neutral position as soon as they are released by the operator.

statements.subject: pedals
statements.object: slip-resistant surface
statements.object_as_written: slip-resistant surface
statements.object_normalised: slip-resistant surface
statements.condition: Where there are pedals
statements.quote: Where there are pedals, they must be so designed, constructed and fitted as to allow safe operation by the driver with the minimum risk of incorrect operation. They must have a slip-resistant surface and be easy to clean.

statements.subject: steering system of wheeled machinery
statements.object: reduce the force of sudden movements
statements.object_as_written: reduce the force of sudden movements
statements.object_normalised: reduce the force of sudden movements
statements.condition: In the case of wheeled machinery
statements.quote: In the case of wheeled machinery, the steering system must be designed and constructed in such a way as to reduce the force of sudden movements of the steering wheel or the steering lever caused by shocks to the guide wheels.

statements.subject: differential lock control
statements.object: allows the differential to be unlocked
statements.object_as_written: allows the differential to be unlocked
statements.object_normalised: allows the differential to be unlocked
statements.condition: Any control that locks the differential
statements.quote: Any control that locks the differential must be so designed and arranged that it allows the differential to be unlocked when the machinery is moving.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3.1
statements.object: acoustic/visual warning clause of 1.2.2 applies only to reversing
statements.quote: The sixth paragraph of section 1.2.2, concerning acoustic and/or visual warning signals, applies only in the case of reversing.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery travel movements
statements.object: the driver is at the controls
statements.object_as_written: the driver is at the controls
statements.object_normalised: the driver is at the controls
statements.condition: with a ride-on driver
statements.quote: Starting/moving All travel movements of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver must be possible only if the driver is at the controls.

statements.subject: driver checking position of devices exceeding clearance zone
statements.object: the means of checking easily
statements.object_as_written: the means of checking easily
statements.object_normalised: the means of checking easily
statements.condition: Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone
statements.quote: Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone (e.g. stabilisers, jib, etc.), the driver must be provided with the means of checking easily, before moving the machinery, that such devices are in a particular position which allows safe movement.

statements.subject: other parts that must be in particular positions
statements.object: locked if necessary
statements.object_as_written: locked if necessary
statements.object_normalised: locked if necessary
statements.condition: to allow safe movement, have to be in particular positions
statements.quote: This also applies to all other parts which, to allow safe movement, have to be in particular positions, locked if necessary.

statements.subject: movement of the machinery
statements.object: must depend on safe positioning
statements.object_as_written: must depend on safe positioning
statements.object_normalised: must depend on safe positioning
statements.condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks
statements.quote: Where it does not give rise to other risks, movement of the machinery must depend on safe positioning of the aforementioned parts.

statements.subject: unintentional movement of the machinery
statements.object: must not be possible for unintentional movement
statements.object_as_written: must not be possible for unintentional movement
statements.object_normalised: must not be possible for unintentional movement
statements.condition: while the engine is being started
statements.quote: It must not be possible for unintentional movement of the machinery to occur while the engine is being started.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3.2
statements.object: risk addressed by 3.3.2 is not named in the text
statements.quote: Starting/moving All travel movements of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver must be possible only if the driver is at the controls.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery travelling function
statements.object: a main device
statements.object_as_written: a main device
statements.object_normalised: a main device
statements.quote: The driver must be able to slow down and stop self-propelled machinery by means of a main device.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery travelling function
statements.object: an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device
statements.object_as_written: an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device
statements.object_normalised: an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device
statements.condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device
statements.quote: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device, an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device must be provided for slowing down and stopping.

statements.subject: stationary machinery
statements.object: a parking device
statements.object_as_written: a parking device
statements.object_normalised: a parking device
statements.condition: Where safety so requires
statements.quote: Where safety so requires, a parking device must be provided to render stationary machinery immobile.

statements.subject: remote-controlled machinery
statements.object: devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately
statements.object_as_written: devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately
statements.object_normalised: devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately
statements.condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time
statements.quote: Remote-controlled machinery must be equipped with devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately and for preventing potentially dangerous operation in the following situations: — if the driver loses control, — if it receives a stop signal, — if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, — if no validation signal is detected within a specified time.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3.3
statements.object: Section 1.2.4 does not apply to the travelling function
statements.quote: Section 1.2.4 does not apply to the travelling function.

statements.subject: EssentialRequirement 3.3.4
statements.object: crushing
statements.object_as_written: crushing
statements.object_normalised: crushing
statements.quote: The control systems for pedestrian-controlled machinery must be designed in such a way as to minimise the risks arising from inadvertent movement of the machine towards the driver, in particular: — crushing, — injury from rotating tools.

statements.subject: movement of pedestrian-controlled self-propelled machinery
statements.object: sustained action on the relevant control device
statements.object_as_written: sustained action on the relevant control device
statements.object_normalised: sustained action on the relevant control device
statements.quote: Movement of pedestrian-controlled machinery Movement of pedestrian-controlled self-propelled machinery must be possible only through sustained action on the relevant control device by the driver.

statements.subject: movement while the engine is being started
statements.object: it must not be possible for movement to occur while the engine is being started
statements.object_as_written: it must not be possible for movement to occur while the engine is being started
statements.object_normalised: it must not be possible for movement to occur while the engine is being started
statements.quote: In particular, it must not be possible for movement to occur while the engine is being started.

statements.subject: rotary tool with reverse control engaged
statements.object: it must not be possible to actuate the tool
statements.object_as_written: it must not be possible to actuate the tool
statements.object_normalised: it must not be possible to actuate the tool
statements.condition: except where the movement of the machinery results from movement of the tool
statements.quote: In the case of machinery on which a rotary tool may be fitted, it must not be possible to actuate the tool when the reverse control is engaged, except where the movement of the machinery results from movement of the tool.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3.4
statements.object: travel and reversing speed limits, no relation fits
statements.quote: The speed of travel of the machinery must be compatible with the pace of a driver on foot. In the case of machinery on which a rotary tool may be fitted, it must not be possible to actuate the tool when the reverse control is engaged, except where the movement of the machinery results from movement of the tool. In the latter case, the reversing speed must be such that it does not endanger the driver.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.3.5
statements.object: Steering must stay possible during stopping after power-steering supply failure
statements.quote: Control circuit failure A failure in the power supply to the power-assisted steering, where fitted, must not prevent machinery from being steered during the time required to stop it.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.4.1
statements.object: uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity
statements.object_as_written: uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity
statements.object_normalised: uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity
statements.condition: when moved
statements.quote: Uncontrolled movements Machinery must be designed, constructed and where appropriate placed on its mobile support in such a way as to ensure that, when moved, uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity do not affect its stability or exert excessive strain on its structure.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.4.1
statements.object: excessive strain on its structure
statements.object_as_written: excessive strain on its structure
statements.object_normalised: excessive strain on its structure
statements.condition: when moved
statements.quote: Uncontrolled movements Machinery must be designed, constructed and where appropriate placed on its mobile support in such a way as to ensure that, when moved, uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity do not affect its stability or exert excessive strain on its structure.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.4.2
statements.object: exception to 1.3.8.1: engine guards may lack interlocks under conditions
statements.quote: Moving transmission parts By way of exception to section 1.3.8.1, in the case of engines, moveable guards preventing access to the moving parts in the engine compartment need not have interlocking devices if they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position, providing the latter is in a fully enclosed cab with a lock to prevent unauthorised access.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery with ride-on driver
statements.object: appropriate protective structure
statements.object_as_written: appropriate protective structure
statements.object_normalised: appropriate protective structure
statements.condition: unless this increases the risk
statements.quote: Roll-over and tip-over Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk of rolling or tipping over, the machinery must be fitted with an appropriate protective structure, unless this increases the risk.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery with ride-on driver
statements.object: risk of rolling or tipping over
statements.object_as_written: risk of rolling or tipping over
statements.object_normalised: risk of rolling or tipping over
statements.condition: where there is a risk of rolling or tipping over
statements.quote: Roll-over and tip-over Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk of rolling or tipping over, the machinery must be fitted with an appropriate protective structure, unless this increases the risk.

statements.subject: protective structure
statements.object: adequate deflection-limiting volume
statements.object_as_written: adequate deflection-limiting volume
statements.object_normalised: adequate deflection-limiting volume
statements.condition: in the event of rolling or tipping over
statements.quote: This structure must be such that in the event of rolling or tipping over it affords the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume.

statements.subject: manufacturer or his authorised representative
statements.object: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_as_written: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_normalised: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.condition: for each type of structure concerned
statements.quote: In order to verify that the structure complies with the requirement laid down in the second paragraph, the manufacturer or his authorised representative must, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

statements.subject: essential requirement 3.4.4
statements.object: risk due to falling objects or material
statements.object_as_written: risk due to falling objects or material
statements.object_normalised: risk due to falling objects or material
statements.condition: in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material
statements.quote: Falling objects Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material, the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk and fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure.

statements.subject: self-propelled machinery with ride-on person(s)
statements.object: appropriate protective structure
statements.object_as_written: appropriate protective structure
statements.object_normalised: appropriate protective structure
statements.condition: if its size allows
statements.quote: Falling objects Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material, the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk and fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure.

statements.subject: manufacturer or his authorised representative
statements.object: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_as_written: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.object_normalised: perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed
statements.condition: for each type of structure concerned
statements.quote: In order to verify that the structure complies with the requirement laid down in the second paragraph, the manufacturer or his authorised representative must, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

statements.subject: Annex I, 3.4.4
statements.object: structure must guarantee adequate deflection-limiting volume
statements.quote: This structure must be such that, in the event of falling objects or material, it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume.

statements.subject: means of access (essential requirement 3.4.5)
statements.object: handholds and steps
statements.object_as_written: Handholds and steps
statements.object_normalised: handholds and steps
statements.quote: Means of access Handholds and steps must be designed, constructed and arranged in such a way that the operators use them instinctively and do not use the control devices to assist access.

statements.subject: machinery used to tow or to be towed
statements.object: towing or coupling devices
statements.object_as_written: towing or coupling devices
statements.object_normalised: towing or coupling devices
statements.quote: Towing devices All machinery used to tow or to be towed must be fitted with towing or coupling devices designed, constructed and arranged in such a way as to ensure easy and secure connection and disconnection and to prevent accidental disconnection during use.

statements.subject: machinery with a tow bar load
statements.object: a support with a bearing surface
statements.object_as_written: a support with a bearing surface
statements.object_normalised: a support with a bearing surface
statements.condition: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires
statements.quote: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires, such machinery must be equipped with a support with a bearing surface suited to the load and the ground.

statements.subject: power take-off on self-propelled machinery (or tractor) side
statements.object: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery (or tractor)
statements.object_as_written: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery (or tractor)
statements.object_normalised: a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery (or tractor)
statements.condition: or by any other device offering equivalent protection
statements.quote: On the side of the self-propelled machinery (or tractor), the power take-off to which the removable mechanical transmission device is attached must be protected either by a guard fixed and linked to the self-propelled machinery (or tractor) or by any other device offering equivalent protection.

statements.subject: input shaft on recipient machinery side
statements.object: enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery
statements.object_as_written: enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery

statement.quote: Particular attention must be given to the following points: — the machinery must not start unexpectedly, — the parameters of the machinery must not change in an uncontrolled way, where such change may lead to hazardous situations, — the machinery must not be prevented from stopping if the stop command has already been given, — no moving part of the machinery or piece held by the machinery must fall or be ejected, — automatic or manual stopping of the moving parts, whatever they may be, must be unimpeded, — the protective devices must remain fully effective or give a stop command, — the safety-related parts of the control system must apply in a coherent way to the whole of an assembly of machinery and/or partly completed machinery.
